description: Tree to 30 m. Twigs terete, angled or compressed, the bark pale brown or reddish brown. Leaves with petiole 5–7 mm; lamina 7–10.8 by 1.9–3.8 cm, ovate, lanceolate or elliptic, base cuneate, apex acuminate; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 11–17 pairs, intramarginal vein 1. Inflorescence up to 3.5 cm, both terminal and in the upper axils, paniculate, solitary or with several branches from the base; peduncle up to 15 mm, rachis and branches angled or terete. Flowers white, sessile. Hypanthial cup 3.7–4.5 mm, funnel-shaped. Pseudostipe 2 mm. Calyx 5, 0.2–0.4 mm, triangular. Petals 5, 0.9–1.3 mm, orbicular, 5–15 gland dots per petal. Outer stamens 0.9–1 mm; anther 0.15–0.2 by 0.3 mm, wider than long, globose, divaricate. Style 1.4–1.5 mm, approximating the stamens. Ovary 2-locular, ca 6 ovules per locule. Fruits (immature) depressed, globose.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Acmena acuminatissima. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 780. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Glabrous. Leaves usually quaternate, rarely decussate; lamina narrowly obovate to elliptic, mostly 4–10 cm long, mostly 2–5 cm wide, attenuate at the base to a petiole mostly 4–12 mm long, rounded to obtuse at the apex, dull on both sides; venation pinnate with the midrib raised in the basal part and otherwise obscure. Inflorescences many at the nodes and along the internodes and epicortical runners, sessile 1- to 3- (usually 2-) flowered umbels; pedicels (0.5–)2–4 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 5- or 6-merous, 13–22 mm long, usually slightly inflated at the base, rounded at the apex, mostly red, orange or yellow below and green above, sometimes with a purple zone at the tip. Anther 2–5 mm long, sessile or much longer than the free part of the filament.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Amyema beccarii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 667. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Glabrous but often glaucous, robust. Leaves opposite or scattered; lamina oblong to ovate or broadly elliptic, 7–15 by (2–)3.5–7 cm, thick, truncate or shortly cuneate at the base to a dark-coloured petiole 10–25 mm long, rounded at the apex, dull on both sides; venation pinnate with the midrib and the main laterals distinct on both sides and the midrib prominent and dark-coloured below. Inflorescences at the nodes, a raceme of 1–5 decussate pairs of triads with all flowers pedicellate; axis 3–20 mm long; peduncles of the triads 1.5–5 mm long; pedicels of the flowers 0.5–2 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 6-merous, 45–70 mm long, robust, gradually widened upwards, weakly clavate and obtuse at the apex, red in the lower part, usually dark purple, brown or black at the apex; tube in the open flower 30–48 mm long. Anther 2–3.5 mm long, obtuse, about half as long as the free part of the filament. Style articulate ca 0.5 mm above the base.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Amylotheca duthieana. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 668. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomatous herb up to 2.5 m; base of shoot and young shoots provided with a dense cover of long, soft, reddish-brown hairs. Stem thin, hollow but stiff, with stattered patent and glandular hairs. Leaves few, large, bipinnate or tripinnate compound; stipules partly joined to the petiole, scarious, up to 2 cm, free part bilobed, 4–6 mm, triangular, acute; petiole 15–40 cm with long patent hairs; leaflets narrowly ovate, sessile or petiolate up to 2 cm, middle one symmetric, the two lateral ones strongly asymmetric, base rounded to cordate, apex long acuminate; margin serrate, upper surface dark green or reddish with scattered stiff hairs, lower one pale with prominent tomentose veins. Inflorescence large, terminal panicles up to 40 by 20 cm. Flowers small, white or reddish, subtended by a persistent, narrow, serrate bract ca 2 mm; pedicels 1–2 mm with 1–2 minute bracteoles; sepals ovate, glabrous, 1–2 mm; petals absent or 1–2 minute; stamens 5–10(–12), filaments 2–3 mm; anthers orbicular; ovary of 2 almost free carpels. Carpels divergent, 4–5 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Astilbe rivularis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 915. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Small often diffuse shrub less than 2 m sometimes with weeping branches. Outer bark light grey-brown. Twigs grey-brown, soon flaking, with the fissures red-brown tomentose. Stem swollen below nodes. Leaves acerose, 3–8 by 1 mm, flat or channeled, thick, base decurrent. Petioles minute (ca. 1 mm) or absent. Flowers axillary, usually solitary. Bracts minute (ca. 3 by 1 mm). Pedicels minute (ca. 1 mm). Calyx narrowly infundibuliform with raised pustulate glands, ca 3 mm; lobes obtuse ca 1 mm. Pseudostipe absent. Petals white pink, ca 2 mm long. Stamens (8–)10 with the connective expanded into an apical gland (ca. ⅓ as long as the anther). Style 1–1.5 mm, stigma globose. Hypanthium deeply cup-shaped, glabrous. Fruits ca 1.5 by 1.5 mm, brown, topped by persistent calyx lobes and style. Seeds ca 0.5 mm, minutely-tuberculate, reniform.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Baeckea frutescens. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 782. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Glabrous except for a dense rusty stellate tomentum on the young vegetative parts and inflorescences. Stem internodes somewhat angular when young but soon terete. Leaves opposite or displaced, with pairs of normally developed leaves usually separated by one or more pairs of vestigial ones; normally developed lamina narrowly ovate to ovate, 6–16 by 2–7.5 cm, cuneate to truncate at the base to a petiole 5–17 mm long, acuminate and acute at the apex, dull on both sides; venation pinnate with the midrib visible above and prominent below and other venation obscure; vestigial leaves 5–7 mm long, channeled above, deciduous. Inflorescences at the nodes, a 6- to 12-flowered capitate spike; axis 1–2 mm long; bracts ca 0.5 mm long, concave. Flowers unisexual, dioecious. Corolla in mature bud cylindric or somewhat narrowed in the middle, angular, obtuse, in male flowers ca 4 mm long, in female flowers 2.5–3 mm long, usually white to yellow but sometimes pink or red. Anther ca 1.5 mm long, sessile.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Baratranthus axanthus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 668. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrubs 1–5 m high; most parts with stellate hairs. Branchlets more or less terete. Leaves remotely to very serrate, 2.5–16 x 0.6–3.6 cm; petiole ± sessile to ca 80 mm; upper surface, sometimes pubescent, tip acuminate, base cuneate or decurrent or winged, stipules reduced to a line. Inflorescence terminal and or axillary, thyrsoid to spiciform, ca 1.5–31 x 0.5–2 cm, cymes sometimes subtended by a narrowly linear to lanceolate bract 1.5–5 x ca 0.5 mm, sometimes sparsely scaly, and sometimes exceeding length of cymes. Calyx campanulate, entire, 2–3.5 x 1–2.25 mm, inside usually glabrous, sometimes puberulent, teeth 1–1.75 x 0.5–1 mm, narrowly triangular to triangular, apex acuminate, occasionally puberulent with scattered groups of scales, margins sometimes glabrous or puberulent, somtimes with a linear-lanceolate bracteole 1.5–2.25 mm long. Corolla: lobe margins and inside usually glabrous, white, (yellowish-brown and dark red has been recorded); tube 3–6 x 1–1.5 mm; mouth sometimes slightly constricted, with a broad ring of dense usually pilose hairs extending to top of stamens, hairs less dense towards base of tube; lobes 0.75–1.75 x 0.05–1.5 mm, campanulate usually orbicular, sometimes crenate. Stamens clavate, deeply cordate at base, included, top of anthers about level with mouth, 0.5–1 mm; filament ± sessile–0.75 mm, usually about half length of anther. Ovary usually glabrous; conical, pyriform to ovoid, gradually tapering or abruptly narrowed into style, bottom of ovary often with irregular saccate ring; stigma clavate, usually glabrous; pistil 1.75–3.5 mm; ovary 1–1.75 x 0.5–0.75 0.3–0.7 mm, stigma 0.5–0.75 mm; style ca 0.25–1 mm. Capsule conical, 3–4.5 x 1.25–2.25 0.5–1.75 mm. Seeds reticulate, ellipsoid to irregular, 0.5–1 x 0.2–0.35 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Buddleja asiatica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 656. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrubs, 0.8 4 m high; most parts densely stellate. Branchlets slightly rectangular. Leaves shortly petiolate to almost sessile, serrate, acuminate, blade usually decurrent, adaxially gla brous, slightly tomentose or pubescent, abaxially rusty on drying, 3.5–17 x 1–7 cm, stipules small, rounded to triangular, truncate, leaf-like; petiole, ± sessile–15 mm. Inflorescence terminal, spiciform, dense, 5.5–26 x 1–3.5 cm, cymes sometimes interrupted low down, sometimes with a narrowly lanceolate bract 12–22 x 1–3 mm. Calyx campanulate, ca 4–5 mm; teeth ca 1.5–2 x 1.5–3 mm, triangular to narrowly triangular, apex acuminate, inside glabrous; sometimes with a small linear lanceolate bracteole ca 2–4.5 mm. Corolla pinkish to blue to orange, throat sometimes dark orange; tube ca 7–11 x 2–3 mm, mouth with ring of pilose hairs, extending to top of ovary, ± glabrous lower down, outside glabrous under calyx; lobes ivory, margins sometimes slightly pubescent, ca 2–2.5 x 2–3 mm, rounded to slighty crenate. Stamens ± sessile; anthers parallel, oblong, ca 2 x 0.5 mm, top of anther + 0.1 mm below mouth, deeply cordate ± divergent. Ovary conical to ellipsoid, gradually narrowing into style, densely stellate; stigma clavate, glabrous with some hairs on the stigmatic area; pistil ca 6.5 mm; ovary 3–3.5 x 2–1.5 mm, stigma 1.25 mm; style 1.75–2.25 mm. Capsule ovoid ca 10 x 3.5 x 3 mm. Seeds irregular, ca 2–2.5 x 0.3–1 mm, reticulate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Buddleja macrostachya. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 659. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Scrambling shrub or climber. Branchlets terete, ± furrowed. Leaves petiolate, entire, sometimes remotely sinuate, moderately broad, base ± attenuate to rounded occasionally sub cordate, apex acuminate, underside of immature leaves densely stellate, rusty on drying, ma ture leaves ± moderately stellate. Stipules reduced to a line. Bracts narrowly linear, some very long. Inflorescence terminal and axillary in upper leaves, rather lax, and open, panicu late to thyrsoid; peduncles sessile to long especially towards base of inflorescence. Calyx companulate with very broad, short triangular teeth usually less than 0.25 x the length of the tube. Corolla yellow, orange to salmon; narrowly tubular, sometimes narrowing towards tube-base. Anthers barely included, usually showing in mouth. Ovary sub-globose, densely stellate, base becoming glabrous, style base densely stellate then becoming ± stellate; stigmatic area sometimes with a few villous hairs. Fruit baccate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Buddleja madagascariensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 659. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub or small tree. Branchlets furrowed, terete to sub-terete, mature growth ± stellate. Leaves petiolate, ovate, to oblong, sub entire-serrate, remotely sinuate to crenate decurrent into petiole; upper surface sparsely to densely stellate, mature leaves ± stellate, sometimes slightly bullate. Stipules linear or very small and leafy. Inflorescence in interrupted panicles, terminal and axillary in upper leaves. Bracts lanceolate, sometimes long. Calyx campanulate, teeth triangular, usually more than 0.3 x the length of the tube. Corolla pinkish-cream to lavender, or tube mauve with limb white, usually with orange throat; narrowly tubular; densely stellate, ± glabrous towards base. Top of anthers just below mouth of tube. Ovary ovoid bottle shaped, densely stellate ± glabrous towards base; style ± stellate, with apex glabrous. Fruit a capsule, sparsely ± stellate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Buddleja paniculata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 660. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub or tree to 10 m. Outer bark grey-brown, inner bark light brown. Leaves lanceolate, 4–11.3 by 1 cm, acute, flat, margins ciliate, outer veins 0.5 mm from the margin forming an intramarginal-like vein; true intramarginal vein absent, upper and lower surfaces drying light green, silky when young, the lamina glabrous when mature often villous at the base. Petioles absent. Flowers usually 5-merous, in dense bottle-brush-like spikes. Pedicels absent. Calyx infundibuliform, 5–6 mm, villous; lobes rounded 1–2 mm, villous. Pseudostipes absent. Petals white, ca 4 mm long, obovate, strongly glandular pustulate, villous. Stamens prominent, numerous, filaments red, 1–3 cm, connective not forming a distinct gland. Style 1–3 cm, stigma capitate. Hypanthium deeply cup-shaped, pubescent when young.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Callistemon citrinus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 784. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree to 10 m. Twigs terete or compressed, the bark greyish white or brown. Leaves with petiole 1.2–1.7 mm, lamina 21.2–23.6 by 6.6–7.3 cm, elliptic or oblong-elliptic, base cuneate, apex acute; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 10–13 pairs, intramarginal vein absent. Inflorescence up to 13 cm, from the axils of fallen leaves, peduncle up to 45 mm, rachis and branches terete, compressed or angled; bracteoles 2 by 0.4 mm, triangular. Flowers white, sessile, usually in threes, sometimes in twos or in fours at the branchlet ends. Hypanthial cup 6.3–6.4 mm, broadly funnel-shaped. Pseudostipe 1–1.5 mm. Calyx 8.6 8.9 mm diam., calyptrate, apex 1–1.2 mm, rostrate. Petals 4, 3.7–4.8 mm, orbicular, rim hyaline, cohering and attached to the inside of the calyx, 75–120 gland dots per petal. Outer stamens 7–8.2 mm; anther 0.3–0.4 mm, oblong. Style 6.4–9.5 mm, approximating the stamens. Ovary 2-locular, 19–21 ovules per locule. Fruits unknown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Cleistocalyx khaoyaiensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 785. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree, height unknown. Twigs terete or compressed at nodes, the bark brownish. Leaves with petiole 7–11 mm, lamina 7–10.5 by 3–4.9 cm, elliptic, obovate or oblanceolate, base cuneate, apex acute, rounded or retuse; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 11–14 pairs, intramarginal vein 1. Inflorescence up to 7 cm, corymbose, both terminal and in the upper axils; peduncle 1.5–3 mm, rachis and branches 4-angled and slightly winged. Flowers sessile, usually in threes at the branchlet ends. Hypanthial cup 6–7 mm, funnel shaped. Pseudostipe 2 mm. Calyx 4.3 4.7 mm diam., calyptrate, apex hollow. Petals 4, 2.7–3.7 mm, orbicular, rim hyaline, cohering and attached to the inside of the calyx. Outer stamens 9.5–11 mm; anther 0.5 mm, oblong elliptic. Style 7.5–12 mm, not exceeding the stamens. Ovary 2-locular, 8–9 ovules per locule. Fruits (immature) oblong ovate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Cleistocalyx nigrans. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 788. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree to 8 m. Twigs terete, the bark reddish brown. Leaves with petiole 9–10 mm, lamina 7–10.4 by 2.9–4.4 cm, elliptic, oblong-elliptic or oblanceolate, base cuneate, apex acute or acuminate; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 11–14 pairs, intramarginal veins 2. Inflorescence up to 7.5 cm, both terminal and in the axils, paniculate; peduncle absent or up to 30 mm, rachis and branches angled. Flowers white, sessile, usually in threes at the branchlets ends, sometimes in twos, or clustered. Hypanthial cup ca 6.5 mm, funnel-shaped. Pseudostipe ca 2 mm. Calyx 5.2–5.7 mm diam., calyptrate, apex 0.7 mm, rostrate, Petals 4, 2.4–3.2 mm, orbicular, cohering and attached to the inside of the calyx, 75–100 gland dots per petal. Outer stamens 5.1–5.4 mm; anther 0.7 mm, oblong. Style 6.5–9 mm, approximating the stamens. Ovary 2-locular, 15–16 ovules per locule. Fruits (imma ture) ovate.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 10 m. Outer bark light grey-brown, soon flaking. Leaves ovate obovate or elliptic, 3–9 by 2–4 cm, acute or obtuse, rarely acuminate, flat, margins revolute, with 5–12 obscure secondary veins and a faint intramarginal vein 1–2 mm from margin, upper surface drying dark brown/black, lower surface drying light brown, glabrous. Petioles 3–12 mm, glabrous, old angled. Flowers usually 4-merous, axillary, in few flowered inflorescences, hermaphrodite or staminate. Bracteoles lanceolate, ca 1 mm. Pedicels 5–8 mm. Calyx infundibuliform with raised pustulate glands, 2–3 mm; lobes obtuse ca 1 mm, glabrous or rarely sparsely pubescent. Pseudostipe absent. Petals white, 3.5 mm long, ciliate. Stamens with filaments ca 4 mm, connective not forming a distinct gland. Style 2–3.5 mm, stigma, capitate. Fruits ca 4 mm. Seeds ca 1.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Decaspermum montanum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 790. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub or tree to 10 m. Outer bark grey-brown, soon flaking. Leaves ovate or elliptic, 1–10 cm by 0.5–4 cm, usually acuminate, flat, with 10–20 obscure secondary veins and a faint intramarginal vein 1–1.5 mm from margin, main vein usually sericeous at least beneath. Petioles 3–5 mm, young sericeous, old angled. Flowers 4 or 5-merous, axillary, often in many flowered inflorescences, hermaphrodite or staminate. Bracteoles lanceolate, minute 1 mm. Pedicels ca 3 mm. Calyx infundibuliform with raised pustulate glands, ca 3 mm; lobes obtuse ca 1 mm, often sericeous. Pseudostipe absent. Petals white or pink, ca 3.5 mm long, ciliate. Stamens with filaments ca 5 mm, connective forming a minute gland. Style ca 3 mm; stigma capitate. Fruits small, dark purple/black when ripe, often sericeous, topped by persistent calyx lobes. Seeds 2–3 mm, tuberculate, very strongly curved.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Decaspermum parviflorum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 791. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Flowers 5-merous. Calyx 1–2.5 mm, calyx-lobes 0.5–1 mm. Petals 2.5–5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Decaspermum parviflorum parviflorum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 793. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Flowers 4-merous. Calyx 1–2 mm, calyx-lobes 0.5 mm. Petals 3–4.5 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Decaspermum parviflorum quadripartitum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 793. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Glabrous except for young shoots, inflorescences and flowers ochre to red-brown stellate hairy, eventually glabrescent except for the ovary. Leaves opposite or scattered; lamina narrow ovate to ovate, 8–21 by 3–10 cm, truncate or weakly cordate at the base to a petiole 3–12 mm long, acuminate and acute at the apex, somewhat lustrous above, dull below; venation pinnate with the midrib prominent and raised below and the midrib and main laterals distinct and depressed above with the lamina bullate between them. Inflorescences at the nodes, a (25–)30 to 60-flowered raceme; axis 15–80 mm long; pedicels 1–2.5 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 5-merous, 23–35(–40) mm long, slender, weakly clavate and obtuse at the apex, red or orange, sometimes green above; tube in the open flower 16–19 mm long with the lobes reflexed 2–3 mm higher, curved. Anther 1.5–3.5 mm long, obtuse or with a bluntly acute mucro, about one third to almost as long as the free part of the filament,

description: Glabrous except for the young shoots, inflorescences and flowers with a short dense white or ochrous stellate tomentum which persists on the ovary, corolla and stamen filaments, otherwise eventually glabrescent. Leaves scattered or subopposite; lamina narrowly to broadly ovate, 10–30 by (2–)4–6 cm, shortly attenuate to truncate or slightly cordate at the base to a petiole (7–)10–30 mm long, thin, acuminate and acute or obtuse at the apex, darker and somewhat glossy above or dull on both sides; venation pinnate with the midrib and the incurved main laterals distinct on both sides and more prominent below. Inflorescences at the nodes, a 12- to 40-flowered raceme; axis 50–85 mm long; pedicels 0.3–4 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 5-merous, (40–)50–110 mm long, relatively slender, sometimes distinctly narrowed above a globosely or ellipsoidally inflated base (not strongly developed in Thailand), gradually widened upwards, weakly clavate and acute at the apex, mostly pink or red below and green above; tube in the open flower 40–85 mm long, more deeply slit on one side, with the lobes reflexed 3–8 mm higher, curved. Anther 3–7 mm long, obtuse, equal to or slightly longer than the free part of the filament.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Dendrophthoe incarnata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 671. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Young parts with a thick creamy-white floccose indumentum, which persists on the inflorescences and flowers, and for some time on the leaf undersides. Leaves opposite, subopposite or scattered-alternate; lamina lanceolate to ovate or oblong, 10–18 by 5–12 cm, cuneate to truncate at the base to a petiole 7–12 mm long, thickly coriaceous, weakly attenuate and obtuse or broadly acute at the apex; venation pinnate, visible on both sides. Inflorescences at the nodes, a 10- to 20-flowered raceme; axis slender, 20–30 mm long; pedicels 3–5 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 4- or 5-merous, 23-40 mm long, almost uniformly slender, weakly clavate and bluntly acute at the apex, greenish cream to orange to greenish brown beneath the indumentum; tube in the open flower 12–20 mm long, curved, more deeply slit on one side, with the lobes reflexed 5–10 mm higher, sometimes unilaterally. Anther ca 5 mm long, curved, blunt, about as long as the free part of the filament. Fruit widest above the middle.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Dendrophthoe kerrii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 672. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Densely red-brown hairy on the young vegetative parts, inflorescences and flowers, later glabrescent on the stems and leaf upper surfaces. Leaves opposite or scattered; lamina narrowly ovate, mostly 5–16 by 2–5 cm, truncate or slightly cordate at the base to a petiole 5–25(–35) mm long, acuminate and broadly acute at the apex, glossy above, dull below; venation pinnate with the midrib and main laterals distinct above and prominent below. Inflorescences at the nodes, a 3- to 10-flowered spike (flowers rarely subsessile); axis (4–)6–30(–60) mm long; bracts somewhat foliaceous, 3–15 by 1.5–5 mm, mostly long acuminate, appressed to and extending beyond the ovary. Corolla in mature bud 5-merous, (20–)28–55 mm long, globose at the base, uniformly widened above, weakly clavate and obtuse at the apex, mostly red pink or yellow beneath the indumentum; tube in the open flower 15–30 mm long, more deeply split on one side, with the lobes reflexed 6–10 mm higher, curved. Anther 3–4 mm long, acute, slightly shorter than the free part of the filament.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Dendrophthoe lanosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 673. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Glabrous except for the ovary sometimes white tomentose and the staminal filaments sometimes very sparsely papillate or with a tuft of hairs below the anther. Leaves opposite, subopposite or scattered-alternate; lamina ovatę to nearly orbicular, 7–11 by 4–6 cm, cuneate at the base to a short winged petiole 1–5 mm long, often undulate at the margin, rounded at the apex, relatively thick, dull on both sides, venation pinnate with the midrib and main laterals faintly visible on both sides. Inflorescences axillary, a 16- to 30-flowered raceme; axis 35–45(–60) mm long; pedicels in pseudowhorls of 2–4, (1–)3–5 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 5- or rarely 4-merous, 30–45(60) mm long, slender, broadly acute or obtuse at the apex, pink to red below, yellow to orange above, tube in the open flower ca 30 mm long with the lobes reflexed ca 3 mm higher, slightly curved. Anther ca 6, 5 mm long, obtuse, slightly longer than the free part of the filament.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Dendrophthoe longiflora. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 674. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Glabrous except for the young shoots, inflorescences and flowers with a somewhat silky off-white to grey or less often rusty or brownish tomentum, usually less dense on the distal part of the corolla. Leaves scattered or subopposite; lamina variable, mostly narrowly to broadly elliptic, mostly 6–14 by (1.5–)3–8(–10) cm, attenuate to cuneate at the base to a petiole 5–20 mm long, rounded to rarely acuminate and acute at the apex, darker above, lustrous or sometimes glossy above and dull below or dull on both sides; venation pinnate with the midrib and the somewhat curvinerved main laterals usually visible on both sides. Inflorescences at the nodes, a 6- to 12-flowered raceme; axis 10–20(–35) mm long; pedicels (0.5–)1–4 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 5 merous, 12–20(–28) mm long (longer in some putative hybrids), inflated to ca 5 mm wide and angular or winged in the lower part, narrowed to a neck, clavate and obtuse or rounded at the apex, mostly green or yellow or orange, rarely red; tube in the open flower (2–)6–12 mm long, narrowly to broadly campanulate, usually regular, with the lobes reflexed 4–8 mm higher and together often almost closing the neck. Anther 2–5 mm long, obtuse, longer or shorter than the free part of the filament; filament often with very sparsely scattered stellate hairs.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Undershrub, 1–2.50 m high; bark greyish-brown, with large pith. Leaves elliptic, obovate to oblanceolate, 13–20 by 5–9 cm, apex acuminate, base cuneate or attenuate, margin serrate, sparsely pubescent on both surfaces; nerves 8–11 pairs, finely arched and more or less anastomosing near margin; petiole slender, 2–5 cm long, sparsely hairy, then glabrescent. Panicles pubescent, 6–15 cm long, 5–10 cm wide; peduncle 5–10 cm long; pedicel ca 1 cm long; calyx-tube, 6–8 toothed, campanulate, glabrous inside, sparsely hairy outside. Petals 4–7, oblong or ovate, acute or obtuse; pale to dark blue, glabrous, 6–7 by 2.5–3 mm. Stamens 10 or 20, epigynous, filaments adherent to the corolla; filaments glabrous, filiform 4–5 mm long; anthers oblong or ovate, ca 2 mm long, blue, longitudinally dehiscent. Ovary ovoid or conical. Styles ca 5 mm long. Stigmas blue. Berry globose, ca 5 mm diam; sparsely hairy to glabrous; intense glossy blue when ripe, crowned by the persistent calyx and styles. Seeds numerous, small, obovoid, reticulate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Dichroa febrifuga. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 662. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Glabrous. Leaves opposite; lamina narrowly to broadly ovate, 6–14 by 3–8 cm, cuneate to truncate at the base to a petiole 7–25 mm long, sometimes recurved at the margin, somewhat acuminate and broadly acute at the apex, dull on both sides, sometimes paler below. Inflorescences at the nodes, a pedunculate spike of 1–3 decussate pairs of flowers; peduncle (1–)5–10(–15) mm long, more or less terete, subtended by 1–3 pairs of small bracts at the base; flower-bearing axis 5–20 mm long, with decussate hollows ca 6 mm long; central bracts 7–12 by 4–6 mm, keeled, acute; lateral bracts as long as the central ones, keeled, obtuse. Corolla in mature bud 6-merous, 40–65 mm long, with a distinct nectar chamber at the base, gradually widened upwards, weakly winged above the middle, narrowed to a neck, clavate and acute at the apex, mostly red, orange or pink below, often blue-grey above; tube in the open flower 25–45 mm long, split slightly deeper on one side, with the lobes reflexed or twisted 5–10 mm higher. Anther 2.5–3.5 mm long, constricted at the base, acute, about halfas long as the free part of the filament.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree 10–35 m. Twigs glabrescent, hairs 0.1 mm or less. Leaves: blade membranous or chartaceous, elliptic to oblong, 8–30 by 4–13.5 cm, base subcordate or cuneate; upper surface dark brown on drying; midvein ± flat above; nerves 11–19 pairs, the marginal arches distinct or not above; reticulation lax, flat, distinct or not on both surfaces, leaf bud with dense hairs 0.1–0.2 mm long or less. Inflorescences generally behind the leaves, (sub)glabrescent, with hairs ca 0.1 mm, loose or condensed, many-flowered, 6–25 by 3–15 cm. Male flowers: pedicel 1.5–2.5 mm long; bud 3- or 4- (or 5-)lobed, lobes splitting the bud to ¾–⅘ deep; synandrium depressed-globose, 0.3–0.5 by 0.5–0.6 mm, subcircular in transverse section, anthers 4–6, androphore rather broad, 0.3–0.4 mm long. Female flowers incompletely known. Infructescences of 1–6 fruits, in long panicles 15–25 cm long. Fruits ellipsoid-oblong, glabrous, base rounded or narrowed at base, (4.5–)5–7 by 2.5–3.5 cm; dry pericarp 2–10 mm thick; stalk 15–20 mm long; aril at apex laciniate for ca ⅓ to nearly halfway; seeds 4–5 cm long, apex subacute or bluntly beaked up to 3 mm long, testa with lengthwise irregular purplish flecks.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree 5–50 m. Twigs soon glabrescent. Leaves blade membranous or chartaceous, elliptic to oblong-oblanceolate, (12–)15–35(–40) by (4–)5–12 cm; upper surface usually dark brown on drying; midvein flat or slightly raised above; nerves 11–24 pairs, level or slightly raised above; reticulation lax or rather fine, slightly trabeculate, distinct on both surfaces or not; leaf bud with hairs ca 0.1–0.2 mm long or less. Inflorescences condensed or lax, usually much branched, 8–25 cm long. Flowers in widely spaced clusters of 4–10, of different stages of development; pedicels and perianths sparingly to densely short-pubescent with grey hairs ca 0.1–0.2 mm. Pedicels of male and female flowers slender, 1.5–2.5 mm long. Male flowers 3 or 4-(or 5-)lobed, lobes splitting the bud to (⅔–)¾–⅚ deep inside greenish, yellowish, or red; synandrium (depressed)globose or ellipsoid, (0.3–)0.4–0.5 by 0.3–0.5 mm, anthers (3 or) 4, androphore slender, (0.2–10.3–0.6 mm long. Ovary ovoid, with broad 2-lipped stigma. Infructescences 10–30 cm long with 3–12 fruits. Fruits narrowly to broadly ellipsoid or ovoid, base sometimes shortly contracted, (2.2–)3–5.5 by (1–)1.2–2.5 cm; dry pericarp 1–2.5 mm thick; stalk 5–15 mm long; aril laciniate at apex to ca ⅕; seeds ca 2–3 cm long, apex acute or shortly beaked, testa variegated by longitudinal markings.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 10 m. Outer bark cream, white, grey, white-grey or brown. Twigs angled, glaucous. Leaves (young) alternate, petiolate, lanceolate, ovate or cordate; (mature) alternate, narrowly to broadly lanceolate, usually 15–20 by 3.5–5 cm, petioles 1–2 cm. Flowers in 6–7 flowered axillary clusters. Pedicels absent. Operculum conical. Stamens with filaments ca 4 mm; anthers ca 0.5 mm with a minute apical gland. Fruits usually more or less smooth, 7 by 6 mm, conical, valves (3–)4(–5), slightly protruding, disc forming a small ring.

description: Tree to 10 m. Outer bark grey or white-grey. Twigs angled, glaucous. Leaves (young) alternate, petiolate, broadly lanceolate or ovate; (mature) alternate, narrowly lanceolate, usually 15–20 by 1–4.5 cm, petioles 1–2 cm. Flowers in 3–8-flowered axillary clusters. Pedicels ca 7 mm. Operculum conical, cone much less than 10 mm long. Stamens with filaments ca 2–5 mm; anthers ca 0.5 mm with a minute apical gland. Fruits usually more or less smooth, 6 by 6 mm, conical, valves (3–14(–5), protruding, disc broad, ascending.

description: Tree to 16 m. Outer bark fibrous, red-brown (white-brown/ on twigs). Twigs terete. Leaves glaucous, (young) opposite, more or less sessile, amplexicaul, orbicular to cordate, densely glandular; (mature) alternate, broadly lanceolate and acuminate, usually 11.5 by 2.5 cm. Flowers in 3-flowered umbels. Pedicels absent. Operculum broadly conical with a beak 1–2 mm long. Stamens with filaments 5–8 mm; anthers ca 0.5 mm, with small rounded apical gland. Fruits more or less smooth, 5–8 by 5–9 mm, obconical, valves 3–5, more or less flat or slightly protruding, disc narrow, forming a small ring.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Large tree to 25–40 m. Outer bark white to pinky-white. Twigs angled when young. Leaves (young) alternate, petiolate, ovate, setose; (mature) alternate, very narrowly lanceolate, usually 12–19 by 1–1.5 cm, petioles ca 1.5–2 cm. Flowers in 3-flowered clusters. Pedicels < 4 mm or absent. Operculum patelliform, apiculate. Stamens with filaments 7–9 mm; anthers ca 1 mm with elongated gland ca 40% of their length. Fruits usually more or less smooth, 12–15 by 9–11 mm, ovoid or urceolate, valves 3–4, deeply recessed, disc broad, descending.

description: Large tree to 40 m. Outer bark green to grey green. Twigs angled. Leaves (young) opposite, petiolate, ovate or oblong-lanceolate; (mature) alternate, ovate-lanceolate, usually 10–14 by 3–6 cm, petioles 1.5–2 cm. Flowers in 3–7-flowered clusters forming large terminal corymbs. Pedicels ca 1 cm. Operculum patelliform, apiculate. Stamens with filaments ca 5 mm; anthers ca 0.2 mm with a minute apical gland. Fruits usually more or less smooth, 4 by 4 mm, ovoid or urceolate, valves 3–4, protruding, disc forming a very small ring.

description: Large tree to 45 m. Outer bark light brown. Twigs terete. Leaves (young) opposite, more or less sessile, amplexicaul, ovate; (mature) alternate, narrowly lanceolate or falcate, usually 20 by 2–3 cm, petioles ca 3 cm. Flowers solitary or in 3 or 7-flowered clusters. Pedicels usually absent. Operculum broadly conical with a beak 2–4 mm long. Stamens with filaments 16–20 mm; anthers ca 1 mm with short rounded apical gland. Fruits warty, usually ridged, 20 by 25 mm, broadly obconical, valves 3–5, more or less flat, disc a greatly expanded and flattened ring sometimes covering the valves.

description: Large tree to 50 m. Outer bark grey occasionally purple tinged. Twigs angled. Leaves (young) alternate, petiolate, ovate; (mature) alternate, lanceolate, usually 15–20 by 3–5 cm, petioles 1.5–2 cm. Flowers in 3–7-flowered axillary clusters. Pedicles absent. Operculum conical, with a beak ca 1 mm long. Stamens with filaments ca 7 mm; anthers 0.5–0.8 mm with a small apical gland. Fruits usually more or less smooth and glaucous, 7 by 6 mm, pyriform and distinctly contracted at the apex, valves 4–5, protruding but incurved, disc forming a very small ring.

description: Large tree to 50 m. Outer bark blue-grey. Twigs angled. Leaves (young) alternate, petiolate, ovate to ovate lanceolate; (mature) alternate, lanceolate, usually 15–20 by 2–3 cm, petioles 2–3 cm. Flowers in 7–10-flowered axillary clusters. Pedicels absent. Operculum conical. Stamens with filaments ca 5 mm; anthers 0.5–0.8 mm with a small apical gland. Fruits usually more or less smooth, 9 by 6 mm, conical and distinctly contracted at the apex, valves 3–4, disc narrow forming a ring.

description: Large tree to 50 m. Outer bark grey or red-grey. Twigs angled. Leaves (young) alter nate, petiolate, ovate to subcordate; (mature) alternate, lanceolate, usually 15–22 by 2–3 cm, petioles 2–3 cm. Flowers in 5–10-flowered axillary clusters. Pedicels ca 7 mm. Operculum very long conical. Stamens with filaments ca 15 mm; anthers ca 0.6–0.8 mm with a small apical gland. Fruits usually more or less smooth, 6 by 5 mm, conical, valves 4–5, protruding, disc broad, steeply ascending.

description: Shrub to 2 m. Twigs terete, young shoots, peduncles, bracts and bracteoles rusty pubescent. Leaves with petiole 3–4.9 mm; lamina 5.1–7.2 by 2.1–2.9 cm, sparsely pubescent, ovate or elliptic, base cuneate or acute, apex acute or shortly acuminate; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 8–10 pairs, intramarginal vein 1. Inflorescence up to 1.5 cm, both terminal and in the upper axils, with 1–3 flowers; bracts 3.5 by 1 mm, oblong. Flowers white, woolly with scattered overlying longer hairs, sessile or with pedicel to 10 mm. Hypanthial cup 2.3–3 mm, funnel-shaped. Sepals 4, 2.1–3 mm, oblong. Petals 4, 3.8–4.6 mm, free, ovate oblong, 50–100 gland dots per petal. Outer stamens 3.8–4.2 mm; anther 0.4 mm, ovate. Style 3.8–5.5 mm, approximating the stamens. Ovary 2-locular, 7–11 ovules per locule. Fruits 7–8 mm, globose.

description: Small shrub, height unknown. Twigs terete, the bark whitish grey. Leaves with petiole 2.1–2.5 mm; lamina 3.8–3.9 by 1.7–1.9 cm, ovate or oblong elliptic, base acute or obtuse, apex acute; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 6–7 pairs, intramarginal vein absent. Flowers with long slender peduncle to 2 cm. Hypanthial cup 2 mm, funnel shaped. Sepals 4, 3.6–4.3 mm, oblong to triangular with acute apex. Petals 4, 7–8 mm, free, orbicular or obovate, membranous, petals sparsely gland dotted. Outer stamens ca 5 mm; anther 0.6 mm, oblong. Style 4–6 mm, approximating the stamens. Ovary 2-locular. Fruits 1.5 by 1.5–2 cm, globose.

description: Tree to 4 m. Twigs terete or compressed, the bark greyish or brown. Leaves with petiole 5–8 mm, lamina 7–10.9 by 3.3–4.8 cm, lanceolate, elliptic or ovate, rusty pilose when young, base cuneate or acute, apex obtusely acuminate; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 8–9 pairs, intramarginal vein 1. Inflorescence up to 1 cm, both terminal and axillary, with 1–3 flowers, bracts 1.3 by 0.8 mm, oblong; bracteoles 2 by 1 mm, triangular. Flower woolly with hirsute hairs, sessile or with pedicel to 2 mm. Hypanthial cup 3.1–3.9 mm, funnel-shaped. Sepals 4, 1.5-2.8 mm, semiorbicular or orbicular. Petals 4, 1.9–2.8 mm, orbicular, 60–100 gland dots per petal. Outer stamens 2.1-2.5 mm; anther 0.5-0.6 mm, oblong ovate; style 2.6–2.7 mm, approximating the stamens. Ovary 2-locular, ca 7 ovules per locule. Fruits unknown.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Plant moderately robust, erect, 50–80 cm in diameter. Stems with rudimentary leaves on each growth segment; internodes terete or slightly dilated upwards, those bearing normally developed leaves 30–65 mm long, 1–5 mm in diameter. Leaves rudimentary and normally developed in successive pairs; lamina of normally developed leaves broadly elliptic to broadly ovate, 25–60 by 20–40 mm, cuneate at the base to an obscure petiole 2–4 mm long, rounded at the apex, 3- or 5-nerved; rudimentary leaves in pairs alternating regularly with normally developed ones, 2–4 mm above each leafy node, ragged, ca 1 mm high. Inflorescences commonly terminal, often in threes, sometimes axillary, a spike of 8–10 pairs of triads, 20–35 mm long; internodes 1.5–5 mm long; bracteal cup ca 1 mm long, spreading; bracteoles acute, irregularly serrate, ca 0.5 mm long. Fruit ellipsoid, smooth or finely verrucose, not seen mature.

description: Glabrous except for inflorescences, fruits and young parts shortly rusty tomentose. Leaves opposite or scattered; lamina narrowly elliptic to ovate, 7–12 by (2–)3–6 cm, cuneate to truncate or cordate the base to a distinct petiole 7–15 mm long, acuminate and acute or shortly rounded at the apex, slightly to distinctly lustrous above, dull below; venation pinnate with the midrib visible above and raised below and the main laterals obscure above and visible below. Inflorescences at the nodes, a many-flowered raceme or spike subtended by an involucre of a few narrow bracts up to 1 mm long; axis 30–130 mm long; pedicels 0–1.5(–2.5) mm long; bracts linear to triangular, slightly concave, keeled when longer, appressed, 0.5–1.5(–2.5) mm long. Ovary usually strongly depressed urceolate, ca 1 mm high, 1.5–2 mm wide, rarely more nearly cylindrical and up to 2 mm long; calyx limb erect, less than 0.5 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 4-merous, 6–9 mm long, strongly expanded to 4 semicircular wings in the lower 1.5–2 mm, slender above, weakly clavate and acute to rounded at the apex, red. Anther ca 1.5 mm long, blunt, erect, slightly shorter than the free part of the filament. Style 5–7 mm long, reaching to above the top of the anthers, gradually widened upwards, lacking a constriction; stigma twice as wide as the style.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Glabrous except rarely for a short red-brown tomentum on the young shoots, inflorescences and flowers (not seen in Thailand). Leaves scattered or sometimes subverticillate; lamina broadly elliptic to ovate, 5–10 by 2–6.5 cm, cuneate at the base to a petiole 5–15 mm long, obtuse or rounded at the apex, dull or slightly glossy above, dull below; venation pinnate with the midrib distinct below and the many parallel secondary and tertiary veins obscure but forming a finely striate pattern above. Inflorescences at the nodes, a 3- to 16-flowered raceme or spike; axis 20–60 mm long; pedicels 0 4.5 mm long, up to 2 mm thick; bracts simple, ovate, ca 2 mm long. Ovary cylindric, 5–7 mm long; calyx limb spreading, ca 1 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 5-merous, 17–22(–28) mm long, inflated up to 4 mm wide at the base, gradually narrowed upwards, robust, acute at the apex, yellow to green or pale orange brown. Anther 5–6 mm long, acute, almost as long as the free part of the filament. Style 16–25 mm long, reaching beyond the top of the anthers, slender, lacking a constriction, angular; stigma not wider than the style.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Glabrous except for young internodes and sometimes the inflorescence and flowers sparsely brown tomentose and soon glabrescent. Leaves scattered, subopposite or subverticillate; lamina elliptic or ovate, 5–15(–20) by (0.8–)1.5–6 cm, attenuate or cuneate at the base to a petiole 8–30 mm long, irregular at the apex but normally somewhat attenuate and acute, dull or slightly glossy above, dull below; venation pinnate with the midrib distinct on both sides, the lateral veins usually distinct above and the many parallel tertiary veins obscure but forming a finely striate pattern above. Inflorescences at the nodes and rarely terminal, a few- to 25-flowered raceme; axis 50–250 mm long, angular; pedicels (1–)4–18(–27) mm long; bracts simple, rounded, 1–1.5 mm long. Ovary cylindric, 5–8 mm long; calyx limb spreading, 1–1.5 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 5-merous, (15–)22–30(–40) mm long, often slightly inflated up to 3 mm wide in the lower 2–4 mm, gradually narrowed upwards, acute at the apex, mostly orange-red to bright red, sometimes yellow-white or yellow-green. Anther 5–12 mm long, acute, usually about two thirds as long as the free part of the filament but often longer in Thailand. Style 15–32(–38) mm long, reaching to the top of the anthers, uniformly slender throughout and lacking a constriction; stigma capitate, slightly wider than the style.

description: Glabrous except for all young parts densely brown-tomentose; eventually glabrescent except for the ovary. Leaves opposite or sometimes scattered; lamina lanceolate to ovate, mostly 3–7 by 1–2 cm, attenuate at the base to a petiole 1–6 mm long, acuminate and acute at the apex, thin, dull on both sides but slightly darker above; venation pinnate with the midrib and the main laterals distinct above and the midrib prominent below. Inflorescences at the nodes, a 2- or 3- (rarely to 5-)flowered raceme; axis 5–20 mm long, flattened upwards; pedicels 0.2–2 mm long, subumbellately crowded near the tip of the axis; bracts triangular, acute, ca 1 mm long. Ovary urceolate, 1–1.5 mm long; calyx limb slightly spreading, entire, ca 0.2 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 4-merous, 5–8 mm long, slightly keeled in the lower part, narrowed above, weakly clavate and acute at the apex, yeilow to red or purple. Anther 2–2.5 mm long, obtuse, 1 to 3 times as long as the free part of the filament. Style 5–7 mm long, reaching to the top of the anthers, conical at the base, uniformly slender above, lacking a constriction; stigma capitate, about twice as wide as the style.

description: Glabrous except for the inflorescence and flowers hairy when young, soon glabrescent except sometimes for the inflorescence axis and fruit remaining shortly pale brown-tomentose and the ovary remaining grey-white tomentose. Leaves opposite or subopposite; lamina ovate, 5–18 by 1.5–6(–8) cm, cuneate to truncate at the base to a petiole 5–20 mm long, acuminate and acute at the apex, thin, lustrous or dull on either side; venation pinnate with the midrib and main laterals distinct on both sides. Inflorescences at the nodes, a many-flowered raceme; axis (50–)100–300 mm long; pedicels (0.3–)1–2 mm long, often verticillately clustered; bracts ovate or triangular, sometimes with a dorsal transverse fold, obtuse or acute, 0.7–1.5 mm long. Ovary campanulate, 1, 5–3 mm long; calyx limb entire, spreading, 0.3–0.7 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 5–merous, (3–)4–9 mm long, usually strongly keeled in the lower part, narrowed to a slender neck, clavate and obtuse or rounded at the apex, mostly bright red, rarely almost white. Anther 1–2.5 mm long, obtuse, about equal to the free part of the filament. Style (2–)3–5(–6) mm long, reaching to the base of the anthers, angular in the lower 1–3 mm below a distinct constriction, more slender above; stigma capitate, hardly wider than the style apex.

description: Glabrous except for young inflorescences and flowers sparsely tomentose. Leaves opposite or ternate, often scattered; lamina lanceolate to elliptic or ovate, 10–23 by (2.5–)4–11 cm, cuneate to truncate at the base to a distinct petiole 10–25 mm long, acuminate and acute at the apex, lustrous above, dull below; venation pinnate with the midrib visible above and raised below and the main laterals few and faintly visible above. Inflorescences at the nodes, a many-flowered raceme or spike sometimes subtended by an involucre of a few narrow bracts up to 5 mm long; axis (100–)150–250 mm long; pedicels 0–4 mm long; bracts strongly reflexed, usually with a dorsal spur-like sac, 1–2 mm long. Ovary campanulate or depressed barrel-shaped, 1.2–2 mm long and wide, usually with irregular wrinkles or furrows persisting to the young fruit; calyx limb erect, ca 0.5 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 5-merous, (3.5–)5–7(–9) mm long, slender in the middle, weakly clavate and rounded at the apex, reddish yellow to bright red. Anther 1–1.5 mm long, obtuse, reflexed, slightly shorter than the free part of the filament. Style (2.5–)3–4.5(–5.5) mm long, reaching to the base of the anthers, gradually widened upwards, lacking a constriction, angular; stigma as wide as the style.

description: Glabrous except for the inflorescence and flowers sparsely tomentose when young and soon glabrescent. Leaves opposite, usually displaced and often subverticillate; lamina lanceolate to ovate, (7–)10–25(–30) by (2.5–)14–9(–11) cm, cuneate to truncate at the base to a distinct petiole (8–)12–35 mm long, usually attenuate or shortly acuminate and acute at the apex, slightly lustrous olive green above, dull light brown below; venation pinnate with the midrib and the main laterals faintly to clearly visible on both sides. Inflorescences at the nodes, a many-flowered raceme or spike subtended by an involucre of numerous linear bracts up to 15 mm long; axis (150–)200–500(–850) mm long, 3–5 mm thick in the lower part and attenuate towards the tip: pedicels 0.25–2(4) mm long, often verticillately clustered; bracts deltoid, very concave, often with a sac-like dorsal protuberance, finely acute, 1.5–3 mm long. Ovary cylindric, 3–5 mm long; calyx limb erect, entire, 1–1.5 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 5- to 7-merous, (7–)8–12 mm long, not inflated at the base, clavate and rounded at the apex, yellow, orange or red. Anther 2–2.5 mm long, obtuse, about equal to the free part of the filament. Style (3–)5–8 mm long, reaching to the base of the anthers or lower, gradually widened upwards, lacking a constriction; stigma flat, as wide as the style.

description: Tree 5–30 m. Twigs towards apex terete, glabrescent, at first with hairs 0.1–0.3 mm (var. amygdalina) or 0.5–1 mm long (var. lanata); bark finely striate. Leaves either in 2, 3, or 5 rows, or phyllotaxis mixed; blade membranaceous to subchartaceous, elliptic to oblong, 9–23 by 2.5, 9 cm; upper surface olivaceous brown on drying; lower surface soon glabrescent, without brown or blackish dots; midvein flat to moderately raised above; nerves 7–14 pairs, thin, flat or raised; reticulation faint; leaf bud with hairs 0.1–0.3 or 0.5–1 mm (see the variet ies). Inflorescences either thinly pubescent with pale hairs 0.1–0.2(–0.5) mm (var. amygdalina), glabrescent, or soon glabrescent, at first with hairs densely set, rusty, 0.5(–1) mm (var. lanata); in male 3–4 times branched, 4–22 by 2–12 cm, in female 1–6 cm long; flowers either 2- or 3 (or 4-)lobed, or ± an even mixture of 2- and 3-lobed, in male dispersed or in loose clusters of 4–12, glabrous. Female flow ers ellipsoid, 2–3 by 2 mm; ovary glabrous. Fruits ellipsoid, 2–6 by 1.6–2.6 cm, glabrous, brown on drying; stalk 2–4(–5 when fresh) mm long; perianth not persisting in fruit.

description: Tree 10–35 m. Twigs towards apex = angular or flattened towards the apex, almost always distinctly lined or ridged in between the petioles (sometimes evident only in a part of the material), glabrescent, at first with hairs (0.1–)0.2–0.4 mm long. Leaves in two rows; blade membranous, elliptic-oblong to oblong(-lanceolate), 12–26(–30) by 4–9(–11) cm; upper surface olivaceous or brown on drying, lower surface glabrescent but midvein sometimes tardily glabrescent; not dotted; midvein raised above; nerves 12–20 pairs, raised; reticulation not distinct; leaf bud with hairs 0.2–0.4 mm long. Inflorescences with hairs 0.2–0.5 mm, sometimes glabrescent; in male 3–4 times branched, 7–18(–22) by 5–16(–18) cm, the flowers in loose clusters of 3–6; female inflorescences 3–8 by 2–6 cm; flowers 3- (or 4-)lobed, glabrous. Male flowers bud subglobose or broadly obovoid, 1–1.5 by 1.2–1.8 mm, glabrous; lobes splitting the bud to ½ –⅔ deep; androecium depressed-globose to obovoid, (0.5–)0.7–1 by 0.8–1.2 mm, usually ± 3-angular in transverse section; anthers 6–10, free for ca halfway. Female flowers bud broadly ellipsoid, 2.2–2.5 by 1.8–2 mm; ovary glabrous. Fruits broadly ellipsoid, 2–2.8 by 1.8–2.2 cm, glabrous, (dark)brown on drying; stalk 1.5–3 mm long; perianth not persisting in fruit.

description: Tree 10–25 m. Twigs towards apex terete, glabrescent, tomentum of hairs 0.2–0.5 mm. Leaves in 2 rows; blade coriaceous, elliptic to oblong, 10–20(–28) by 3.5–7(–10) cm; upper surface greenish or brown on drying, lower surface with subpersistent tomentum of interwoven hairs ca 0.1 mm high, glabrescent and then showing scattered blackish dots or dashes; midvein flat above; nerves 11–16 pairs, flat or sunken; reticulation indistinct; leaf bud with hairs 0.2–0.5 mm. Inflorescences tardily glabrescent or with persistent woolly tomentum of hairs 0.2–0.5 mm; in male 3–5 times branched, broadly paniculate, 6–20 by 4–15 cm; in female 3–14 cm long; flowers in loose clusters of 2–7, glabrous, perianth 2-lobed. Male flowers bud globose or slightly transversely ellipsoid, (0.8–)1–1.3 by 1–1.5 mm; lobes splitting the bud to ⅓–⅔ deep; androecium globose, 0.4–0.5 by 0.5–0.8 mm; anthers (3–)4–6. Female flowers bud broadly obovoid, 2–3 by 2–2, 5 mm; ovary glabrous. Fruits ovoid or obovoid, 1.5–2.2 by 1.2–1.8 cm, glabrous, dark brown on drying; stalk 2–5(–7) mm long; perianth persisting in fruit.

description: Tree 10–25(–40) m. Twigs towards apex terete, usually ridged, glabrescent, tomentum minute of hairs 0.1–0.2 mm. Leaves in 2 rows; blade membranous, elliptic-oblong to lanceolate, 10–30(–35) by 3–7(–9) cm; upper surface greenish or blackish on drying, almost always with irregular whitish marks of unknown origin, lower surface soon glabrescent; midvein ± flat above; nerves 10–20 pairs, inconspicuous; leaf bud with hairs 0.1–0.5 mm. Inflorescences with hairs 0.1–0.5 mm long, persistent or glabrescent, in male 3–4 times branched, many flowered, ca 4–18 by 3–7(–10) cm; in female smaller; male flowers in clusters of 3–10; flowers glabrescent, 2-lobed. Male flowers bud subglobose or transversely ellipsoid, some what laterally compressed or not, 1–1.3(–1.5) by (1–)1.2–1.5(–2) mm; lobes splitting the bud ½ –⅔ deep; androecium broadly saucer-shaped, 0.8–1.2 by 1–1.5 mm; anthers 6–10, towards apex incurved and free for 0.2–0.3 mm. Female perianth obovoid or ellipsoid, 1.5–2.3 by 1.3–2 mm; ovary glabrous. Fruits globose, 1.5–2.2 cm diam., glabrous, dark brown to blackish on drying; stalk 5–10 mm long. description: Tree 5–25 m. Twigs towards apex terete, at first with woolly hairs ca 0.5 mm, glabres cent; lenticels usually present. Leaves in 2 rows; blade chartaceous, ovate-elliptic to oblong lanceolate, 10–28 by 4–12 cm, lower surface glabrescent, finely papillose, without dots; midvein often tardily glabrescent above; nerves 9–16 pairs, flat or sunken; reticulation coarse, usually ± trabeculate; leaf bud with hairs ca 0.5 mm long. Inflorescences densely woolly pubescent with hairs 0.3–0.5 mm, in male 6–15 by 4–10 cm, (little) branched, flowers united into dense clusters 5–10 mm diam., each with 80–100 flowers; female inflorescences smaller; flowers 3 (or 4-)lobed, glabrous except towards base; pedicel short (or absent), pubescent. Male flowers bud narrowly obconical, angular, 2–2.5 by 1–1.6 mm; lobes splitting the bud to ¾; androecium elongate; anthers 3–5, sessile, erect, central column narrow, hollow to about halfway. Female flowers bud broadly ellipsoid, ca 3 by 2 mm; ovary broadly ellipsoid, ca 2 by 1.5 mm, pubescent. Fruits ellipsoid-oblong, 2.5–4.2 by 1.7–2.4 cm, hairs ca 0.5 mm, sometimes partly glabrescent; stalk 0.5–2 mm long; perianth not persisting in fruit.

description: Tree 6–25 m. Twigs towards apex ± soon glabrescent, hairs 0.2–0.4 mm long. Leaves in (3–)5 rows; blade membranous to chartaceous, (obovate to) elliptic-oblong to oblong lanceolate, 12–35(–55) by 5–17(–2) cm: upper surface dark (olivaceous-)brown on drying; lower surface soon glabrescent, but some hairs remaining on and near the midvein; dots absent; midvein flat above; nerves 13–18 pairs, flat or slightly sunken above; reticulation a course netwerk, faint above; leaf bud with hairs 0.2–0.4 mm. Inflorescences ± thinly with woolly hairs 0.2–0.4 mm long, in male 2–3 times branched, (5–)7–16 by 3–8(–12) cm; in female 2–8 cm long; flowers in male (2- or)3- or 4- (or 5-)lobed, in female either 2- or 3 lobed, in male arranged in clusters of 3–10; flowers softly pubescent. Male flowers pedicel 1–2(–2.5)mm long, not articulated at base; bud (sub)globose, slightly angular, 2.5–3.5 by 3–4 mm; lobes splitting the bud to ⅔–¾ deep; androecium depressed(-globose), 1–1.6 by 1.5–2 mm; anthers (12–)14–16(–20), sessile. Female flowers ovoid-ellipsoid, 3–4(–5) by 3–3.5 mm; ovary pubescent. Fruits 1–6 per infructescence, ellipsoid(-oblong), (3–)4–6 by 2–2.7 cm, granulate-striate, dark brown on drying, soon glabrescent; stalk 3–8 mm; perianth persisting in fruit.

description: Tree 15–40 m. Twigs pale on drying, contrasting with the brown-black colour of the dried petioles, soon glabrescent, hairs 0.1–0.2 mm. Leaves in 3–5 rows, crowded or not towards the apex; blade membranous to chartaceous, oblong(-lanceolate), (10–)18–24 by 3.5–7 cm; upper surface (dark)brown on drying, lower surface soon glabrescent, without dots; midvein flat or slightly raised above; nerves 12–16 pairs, slender; reticulation hardly visible above; leaf bud with hairs 0.1–0.2 mm long. Inflorescences behind the leaves, glabrescent, tomentum of hairs 0.1–0.2 mm; in male 2 or 3 times branched, 6–12 by 4–6 cm, flowers in loose clusters of 4–10 each; female inflorescences few-flowered, 1.5–3 cm long; flowers 3- or 4- (or 5-) lobed, glabrous. Male flowers bud (depressed-)globose, 1.5–2 by 2–2.5 mm, glabrous; lobes splitting the bud to ⅓–½ deep; androecium (depressed-)globose, 0.8–1 by 1–1.2 mm, almost solid; anthers 7–9. Female flowers bud ca 3 mm long; ovary glabrous. Fruits ellipsoid, 3–5.5 by 2.5–4.5 cm, glabrous, blackish on drying, pericarp (4)5–15(–20) mm thick; stalk 5–7 mm long; perianth not persisting in fruit.

description: Tree 5–20(–40) m. Twigs towards apex tardily glabrescent, at first with woolly hairs 1–1.5 mm. Leaves in 2 rows; blade membranous, elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, 9–27 by 4–10(–12) cm; upper surface brown on drying, lower surface with persistent tomentum of hairs all of about the same size, 0.1–0.8 mm long, without dots; midvein ± flat above; nerves 7–15 pairs, ± flat or sunk above; leaf bud with hairs ca 1.5 cm. Inflorescences with dense woolly hairs 1.5–2 mm long, in male 3 or 4 times branched, 3–12 by 1.5–7 cm; in female few flowered, 2–6 cm long; flowers in small fascicles, 3-(or 4- or 5-)lobed, glabrous. Male flowers bud globose, 1.4–2.5 mm diam.; lobes splitting the bud to nearly halfway; androecium depressed globose, 0.6–0.9 by 1.2–1.7 mm, almost solid; anthers 9–12(–15?). Female flowers bud broadly ellipsoid, ca 2.5 by 2.3 mm; ovary pubescent. Fruits ellipsoid, 1.5–2 by 1.3–1.6 cm, glabrescent, usually with tomentum remaining towards base, brown on drying; stalk 2–6 mm; perianth not persisting in fruit.

description: Tree 6–16 m. Twigs towards apex 1.5–3(–5) mm diam., when young densely tomentulose with hairs ca 0.1 mm long or less, soon glabrescent; bark lower down not tending to crack. Leaves blade chartaceous, oblong to lanceolate, 8–30 by 2–8, 5 cm, greenish brown above on drying, lower surface finely papillate, at first densely tomentose, hairs of mixed sizes, 0.1–0.4 mm, the coarser hairs soon shed and leaving minute scars; midvein flat or slightly raised above; nerves 12–24 pairs, flat or slightly raised above; tertiary venatian fine, areoles 0.5 mm diam, or less, distinct; leaf bud with short hairs. Inflorescences up to 5 mm pedunculate, wart like, 2–8 mm diam., 3–15(–30)-flowered in male; flowers with hairs 0.1 (or less )–0.2(–0.3) mm long. Female flowers (only known in subsp. nicobarica) pedicel ca 6 mm long, bracteole subapical; bud ovoid oblong, ca 6 by 2.5 mm. Fruits ellipsoid, 1.8–2 by 1.2–1.6 cm, with hairs 0.2–1 mm long; stalk 0.5–7 mm long.

description: Tree 6–20 m. Twigs towards apex 3–4(–5) mm diam., striate, tardily glabrescent, at first with hairs 0.2–0.3 mm; bark lower down not tending to crack. Leaves blade chartaceous, elliptic-oblong or lanceolate, 12–27 by 2.5–7.5 cm; olivaceous or brown above on drying, lower surface finely papillose or not, tardily glabrescent, at first with sessile and dendroid hairs of various sizes; midvein flat or slightly raised above; nerves 12–27 pairs, flat above; tertiary veining fine, distinct above; leaf bud with hairs ca 0.5 mm. Female flowers pedicel ca 2 mm long; bud depressed obovoid-oblong, 6–8 by (3–)3.5–4 mm. Fruits broadly ellipsoid, 2.5–3 by 1.8–2.2 cm, with hairs ca 0.5 mm long, at base of fruit to 1–1.5 mm long; stalk 2–4 mm long.

description: Tree 5–10 m. Twigs towards apex 3–4 mm diam., with a dense scurfy tomentum of hairs ca 0.1 mm long; bark lower down not tending to crack. Leaves: blade coriaceous, oblong to lanceolate, 24–35 by 4–10.5 cm, greenish brown above on drying; lower surface almost glabrescent with sessile, stellate hairs 0.1–0.2 mm long, not papillate; midvein flat above; nerves 22–30 pairs, flat and faint above; tertiary veining very fine, raised above; leaf bud with hairs ca 0.1 mm. Inflorescences in male pedunculate for 1–2 mm, irregularly wart-like, ca 4 mm diam., 10–25-flowered; flowers with hairs 0.2(–0.3) mm long. Male flowers pedicel 2–3 mm long, bracteole caducous, apical; bud obovoid-obconical, slender, ca 3.5–4 by 2(–3) mm, inside reddish(?); lobes splitting the bud to ca halfway deep; staminal disc circular, flat, including anthers 1–1.2 mm diam., anthers 7 or 8, minutely stipitate; column slender, ca 2.5 mm long. Female flowers and fruits not seen.

description: Shrub or tree 2–10(–35) m. Twigs towards apex (0.5–)1–2 mm diam., at first with hairs 0.1 mm long or less, soon glabrescent; bark lower down not cracking, nor flaking. Leaves blade membranous or chartaceous, elliptic, obovate, or ovate to lanceolate, 3.5–15(–20) by 1.2–4(–6.5) cm, greenish on drying at both surfaces, lower surface very finely papillate, at first with dense hairs 0.1 mm long, soon glabrescent, dots absent; midvein raised above; nerves (6–)8–14(–20) pairs; tertiary veining (very) fine, distinct; leaf bud with hairs 0.1–0.2 mm. Inflorescences subsesile, simple or forked, up to 5 mm long, in male (2–)5–15-flowered, flowers with grey-brown or rusty hairs, persistent or partially caducous. Male flowers pedicel 5–11 mm long, bracteole subpersistent, median; bud subglobose or broadly obovoid, 2.5–5(–5.5) mm diam., inside pink, lobes splitting the bud to ⅔–⅘; staminal disc ? flat, subtriangular, including anthers 1.7–3 mm diam.; anthers 9–25(–30), completely sessile, closely appressed; column 1–2 mm long. Female flowers pedicel 5–10 mm long; bud ellipsoid to obovoid or subglobose, 4–5 mm long. Fruits ± ellipsoid, ridged, 2–5 by 1.5–3 cm, hairs 0.1–0.2 mm long, sometimes glabrescent; stalk 8–16 mm long.

description: Tree 5–20 m. Twigs towards apex striate, 2–4 mm diam., tardily glabrescent, hairs 0.2–0.5 mm long; bark lower down not tending to crack. Leaves blade thin-coriaceous, oblong to lanceolate, (10–)12–40 by 3.5–12 cm, olivaceous above, lower surface papillate, with persistent tomentum of regularly spaced almost equally long dendroid hairs 0.4–0.8(–1.0) mm long; midvein flat or slightly raised above; nerves 17–30 pairs, ± flat or sunken above; tertiary veining clearly visible; petiole tardily glabrescent; leaf bud ca 15 by 2–3 mm, with hairs 0.2–0.5 mm. Female flowers pedicel 2–4 mm long, bracteole median; bud ovoid, 5–7 by 4–5 mm. Fruits broadly ovoid-ellipsoid, 2–3 by 1.5–2 cm, tomentum of hairs ca 1 mm long; stalk 2–9 mm long.

description: Tree 8–25 m. Twigs towards apex 4–8(–10) mm diam., at first with dense hairs 1–1.5 mm, glabrescent; bark lower down brown to blackish, cracking. Leaves blade coriaceous, oblong to lanceolate, (10–)25–50 by (3–)5–21 cm, base ? cordate, greenish to brown above on drying, faintly papillate below, glabrescent, when immature densely stellate-pubescent; midvein raised above; nerves 20 40(–50) pairs, raised above; tertiary veining fine, distinct, raised or sunk; leaf bud with hairs ca 1 mm. Female flowers: pedicel 1.5–2 mm long; perianth bud ellipsoid or obovoid, 6–8 by 5–7 mm. Fruits (ob)ovoid or subglobose, 2.5–3.5(–4) by 2–2.8 cm, with hairs 1–2 mm; stalk 2–5 mm long.

description: Tree 5–20 m. Twigs towards apex 1–2(–2.5) mm diam., at first with hairs 0.1–0.3 mm long, glabrescent; bark lower down rarely tending to crack, never flaking. Leaves: blade membranous or thin-coriaceous, oblong or lanceolate, 6–18(–24) by 1.5–4(–7) cm, usually with a blackish metallic lustre above on drying; lower surface at first with short sessile stellate hairs ca 0.1 mm long, glabrescent, usually very finely papillose (x 30!); midvein sunk above; nerves 10–18(–22) pairs, faint, flat or sunk above; tertiary veining fine, inconspicuous; leaf bud with hairs 0.1–0.3 mm. Fruits 1–5 per infructescence, ellipsoid, subglobose, or sometimes ± pear-shaped, 1.2–2 by 1–1.5 cm, with hairs 0.1–0.2 mm long, ± glabrescent; stalk 3–10 mm long.

description: Tree 5–12 m. Twigs towards apex 1.5–3 mm diam., glabrescent, at first with hairs 0.3–0.5 mm long; bark lower down not tending to crack. Leaves blade membranous or thin coriaceous, oblong to lanceolate, 13–30 by 2.5–8 cm; greenish brown above on drying; lower surface soon glabrescent, at first with woolly tomentum of hairs to 0.5 mm, minutely papil late; midvein #raised above, nerves 15–25 pairs; flat or slightly raised above; tertiary veining indistinct; leaf bud ca 10 by 2 mm, with hairs 0.3–0.5 mm. description: Tree 5–30 m. Twigs towards apex, 1.5–4 mm diam., at first with hairs 0.1–0.2 mm long, glabrescent; bark lower down not flaking. Leaves blade membranous or chartaceous, elliptic or ovate to oblong-lanceolate, 5–28 by (1.5–)2–10 cm, greenish above on drying; lower surface finely papillate, with scattered blackish brown dots, especially on the veinlets, and with persistent stellate hairs ca 0.1 mm long; midvein raised above; nerves 6–18 pairs, raised above; tertiary veining raised and distinct above; leaf bud with hairs 0.1(–0.2) mm. Inflorescences up to 5 mm pedunculate, warted or ± forked, 2–4 mm long; 3–15-flowered in male, 1–5-flowered in female; flowers with hairs 0.1–0.2 mm long. Male flowers pedicel 5–11 mm long, bracteole minute, subpersistent, median or above; bud globose, 2.5–3 mm diam., reddish or cream inside; lobes splitting the bud nearly to the base; staminal disc subcircular, (almost) flat, including anthers, 1.3–2(–3) mm diam., anthers 8–14; staminal column 0.5–1 mm long. Female flowers pedicel 2–9 mm long; budobovoid, 4–5 by 2.5–3.5 mm. Fruits subglobose or ellipsoid, 1.5 4.7 by 1–3 cm, seemingly glabrescent (scale-like hairs ca 0.1 mm); stalk 3–15 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or tree 2–20 m. Twigs towards apex (1–)2–4 mm diam., at first with hairs 0.5–2 mm long, glabrescent; bark lower down in Thailand flaking (sometimes indistinct in Thailand). Leaves blade membranous or subcoriaceous, oblong to lanceolate, 8–30 by 1.5–9 cm, brown above on drying, lower surface soon glabrescent, not papillate; midvein raised above; nerves 9–25(–30) pairs, raised above; tertiary veining faint or distinct; leaf bud with hairs 0.5–2 mm. Inflorescences simple or furcate, up to 10 mm long, 3–20-flowered in male, 2–10-flowered in female; flowers with hairs 0.2–0.7 mm long. Male flowers pedicel 3–6 mm long, the bracteole median or above; bud depressed globose, 3–3.5 by (3–)4 4.5 mm, inside red; lobes splitting the bud to ⅔–⅘ deep; staminal disc circular, flat or convex, including anthers ca 2 mm diam.; anthers 9–12; column ca 1 mm long. Female flowers pedicel up to 1.5 mm long, bud larger than in male, obovoid, 5–8 by 4–5 mm. Fruits broadly ellipsoid, obovoid, or subglobose, (1–)1.5–2.5(–3) by 1–2(–2.5) cm, with rough hairs 1–2 mm; stalk 2–5 mm long
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree 8–20 m. Twigs towards apex 1.5–2.5(–4) mm diam., glabrescent, at first with scurfy or woolly tomentum of hairs ca 0.1 mm long, sometimes mixed with dendroid hairs up to 0.2 mm long; bark lower down not tending to crack. Leaves: blade chartaceous or thin coriaceous, (ovate-)oblong or lanceolate-linear, 8–24(–33) by 2–8(–9) cm, above olivaceous to brown; lower surface not or hardly papillose, glabrescent, at first with a loose tomentum of stellate and stellate-dendroid hairs 0.2(–0.3) mm long, the tomentum often remaining for some longer period towards the base of the blade and on the petiole; midvein raised above; nerves 16–31 pairs, above flat or sunken; tertiary veining very fine, the areoles less than 0.5 mm diam., distinct above; leaf bud with hairs 0.1–0.2(–0.5) mm. Inflorescences usually pedunculate for 0.5–5 mm, simple or forked, up to 8 mm long; (5–)10–20-flowered in male; flowers with scurfy or woolly hairs 0.1(–0.3) mm long. Male flowers pedicel 5–10 mm long, bracteole minute, soon to tardily caducous, median or above; bud (depressed) globose, 3–4 by 3.5–4.5 mm, reddish inside; lobes splitting the bud to ca ⅘ deep; staminal disc circular or trigonous, flat, including anthers 1.5–2.5 mm diam., anthers (8–)9–16, column slender, 0.5–1.3 mm long. Female flowers pedicel 2–6(–10) mm long; bud ellipsoid-oblong or obovoid, 4–6 by 2–3.5 mm; ovary comparatively long-hairy with hairs 0.5–1 mm long. Fruits ellipsoid, sometimes narrowed at base, 1.8–3.5 by 1.2–2 cm, with conspicuous yellowish brown or rufous shaggy hairs 1–2 mm long, later often shed except for those at the very base, leaving a fine warty surface of the pericarp; stalk 2–8(–12) mm long.

description: Tree 3–20 m. Twigs towards apex terete, 1–2 mm diam., at first with hairs 0.1 mm long or less, glabrescent; bark lower down not flaking. Leaves blade membranous, elliptic or oblong-lanceolate, 7–21 by 2–7 cm, greenish-brown above on drying, lower surface at first with sparse stellate hairs ca 0.1 mm long or less, glabrescent; midvein raised above; nerves 14–20 pairs, raised above; tertiary veining very fine, distinct above; leaf bud with hairs ca 0.1 mm. Inflorescences sessile, simple or furcate, up to 5 mm long; 3–15-flowered in male, 1–6-flowered in female; flowers with hairs 0.1 mm long or less. Male flowers pedicel 7–15 mm long; bracteole caducous, median or above; bud (depressed) globose, 3–4(–4.5) mm diam., cream-coloured (always?) inside; lobes splitting the bud to ca ⅘ deep; staminal disc (sub)circular, flat, including anthers 2–2.3 mm diam., anthers 9–13; staminal column 0.5–1 mm long. Female flowers pedicel 6–10 mm long; bud obovoid, 4–5 by 2.5–3.5 mm. Fruits ellipsoid or obovoid, base often narrowed, 1.2–1.6 by 0.8–1 cm, with hairs 0.2–0.4 mm long; stalk 6–15 mm long.

description: Tree 5–30 m. Twigs towards apex (2–)3–5 mm diam., with hairs 0.05–0.5 mm long; bark lower down not tending to crack. Leaves blade chartaceous or coriaceous, oblong to (ob)lanceolate, 12–40 by 3–12 cm, olivaceous above on drying, lower surface papillate, with persistent hairs, sparse sessile stellate 0.1–0.2 mm long, mixed with larger dendroid hairs (lens x 30); midvein slightly raised above; nerves 18–30 pairs, flat or + sunk above; tertiary veining fine, raised above; leaf bud with hairs to 0.5 mm. Inflorescences sessile, up to 10 mm long, 3–25-flowered in male; flowers with hairs 0.05–0.5 mm long. Male flowers pedicel 4.5–8.5 mm long, bracteole (sub)apical; bud obovoid(-oblong), 4–5.5(–6) by 2.5–4(–4.5) mm, inside reddish; lobes splitting the bud to ½ –⅔ deep; staminal disc ± flat, circular, including anthers 1.5–2 mm diam.; anthers 8–11, half sessile; column 1.5–2.5 mm long, rarely minutely pubescent at base. Female flowers pedicel to 1.5 mm long, bracteole apically; bud ovoid ellipsoid or ellipsoid(oblong), 6–8 by 3.5 4.5 mm. Fruits broadly ovoid, ellipsoid, or ellipsoid oblong, 2.5–5 by 1.5–3.5 cm, with hairs 1–2 mm long; stalk 1–6 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Twigs towards apex 3–4 mm diam., not or faintly angled or faintly flattened, pubescent with dense hairs ca 0.2 mm long. Leaves blade chartaceous, 12–35 by 4–9 cm, base rounded or truncate; petiole 7–14 mm long, apex not or only slightly pulvinate; leaf bud with hairs 0.2–0.5 mm long. Male flowers insufficiently known. Female flowers bud 5–5.5 by 4–4.5 mm. Fruits 2.5–3.2 by 2–2.5 cm.

description: Twigs stout, towards apex (4–)5–10 mm diam., usually coarsely blunt-angled by ridges from bases of petioles downwards; pubescent with hairs 0.5(–1) mm. Leaves blade thin- to rather thick-coriaceous, 18–50 by 4–18 cm, base cordate; petiole short and stout, (5–)8–12 mm long, distinctly pulvinate at transition to blade; leaf bud with coarse hairs 0.2–2 mm long, particularly setose on midrib. Male flowers: pedicel 1–4 mm long; bracteole 2–3 mm long, rather tardily caducous; bud 5–6 by 4.5–6 mm; anthers 12–14. Female flowers not seen. Fruits 3–3.5 by 2.5–3 cm.

description: Tree 6–25 m. Twigs towards apex 3–10 mm diam., subterete or somewhat flattened by ridges from the petiole bases, at first with hairs 0.2–1 mm long; bark lower down not tending to crack. Leaves blade chartaceous or coriaceous, oblong to lanceolate, usually narrowed towards the base, (15–)20–50 by (3.5–)4–18 cm, base rounded or cordate, above olivaceous on drying; lower surface finely papillate, at first with soft stellate-dendroid hairs; midvein flat or raised above; nerves 25–50 pairs, slender, not raised above; leaf bud with bristly den droid hairs 0.2–2.0 mm long; petiole ± pulvinate at apex. Inflorescences sessile, simple or furcate, up to 15 mm long, 5–20-flowered in male; flowers with hairs 0.3–0.8 mm long, perianth reddish inside. Male flowers pedicel 1–6 mm long, bracteole 2–4(–5) mm, soon or tardily caduçous, (sub)apically; bud subglobose or broadly obovoid, 4.5–6 by 4–6 mm; lobes splitting the bud to (½ –)⅔(–⅘) deep; staminal disc subtriangular, ± flat, including anthers 2–3 mm diam.; anthers (7–)9–16, (half)sessile; column stout, 1.5–2 mm long. Female flowers pedicel 0.5–1 mm long; bud obovoid, 5–6 by 4–5 mm. Fruits broadly ellipsoid, (2.5–)3–4 by (2–)2.5–3 cm, with bristly hairs 1.5–3 mm long; stalk 1–2 mm long.

description: Plants 4–10(–20) cm long, relatively slender, much-branched, variable in appearance, sometimes with all branches similar to the main stems and sometimes with flowering branches distinctly narrower than the main vegetative ones, but not strongly differentiated into abruptly distinct vegetative and flowering axes. Stems with 8–25 internodes; basal internode 2–12 mm long, terete and 1–2 mm in diam. when shorter, terete at the base and flattened up to 4 mm wide towards the apex when longer; succeeding internodes of the main stems compressed or flattened, narrowly cuneate to narrowly obovate, 5–12 by 2–4 mm; branches mostly flattened transversely to the plane of flattening of the parent stem; venation with 1 vein distinct and raised. Rudimentary leaves together encircling the node, 0.2–0.5 mm high, usually thin, truncate. Hairs of the floral cushion few or absent, developed from very small bracts, scarcely protruding, reddish. Flowers in 1 or 2 rows, ca 8 per cluster, the opposite clusters meeting and encircling the stem; male flowers usually solitary in each cluster.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Glabrous. Leaves opposite; lamina narrowly ovate to ovate, 9–20 by 3.5–11 cm, shortly cuneate to slightly cordate at the base to a petiole 10–30 mm long, attenuate or acuminate and usually acute at the apex, dull on both sides or slightly lustrous above; venation pinnate with the midrib and the main laterals visible on both sides and the midrib prominent below. Inflorescences at the nodes, a sessile involucrate capitate spike of usually 2 decussate pairs of flowers, involucre (30–)50–85 mm long (c. 30 mm long in the Thailand specimens seen), red, comprising 6–10 pairs of bracts, the upper ones oblong, keeled, acute, very slightly and finely undulate near the apex; floral axis 4–8 mm long; lateral bracts enclosing the flowers 15–30 mm long, keeled, acute. Corolla in mature bud 6-merous, 60–115(–130) mm long (ca. 70 mm long in the Thailand specimens seen), widened upwards for three fourths its length, weakly winged below the neck, clavate and acute to obtuse at the apex, yellow to red, ribbed with yellow to red; tube in the open flower 45 90 mm long, with 1 or 2 deeper splits on one side, with the lobes reflexed 3–6 mm higher. Anther 5–8 mm long, slightly spurred at the base, finely acute, slightly shorter to slightly longer than the free part of the filament.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree to 5 m. Outer bark light grey-brown. Twigs grey-brown, soon flaking. Stem swollen below nodes. Leaves tripliveined, lateral veins faint, also with a very faint intramarginal vein ca 0.5 mm from leaf margin, usually 4–7 times as long as wide, narrowly ovate to obovate, 3 by 0.9 cm, flat, decurrent forming a more or less conspicuous flange, leaf-apex with a deciduous mucro, sericeous when young, glabrous or with a sericeous margin when mature, stipules minute, sericeous. Petioles absent. Flowers axillary, usually solitary. Bracts small ovate (ca. 2 mm). Pedicels absent. Calyx infundibuliform with raised pustulate glands, ca 6 mm; lobes obtuse ca 3 mm. Pseudostipe absent. Petals white, 4–5 mm long. Stamens ca 20 with the connective expanded into an apical gland (ca ⅓ as long as the anther). Style ca 3 mm, stigma pattelliform. Hypanthium shallowly cup-shaped, glabrous. Fruits broadly conical, ca 4 by 8 mm brown, flat-topped. Seeds ca 0.5 mm, angled, sometimes weakly hirsute, reniform.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Glabrous. Stem internodes dilated upwards. Leaves opposite or subopposite; lamina narrowly ovate to ovate, 5–10 by 1.5–3 cm, attenuate or cuneate at the base to a sometimes obscurely defined petiole up to 20 mm long, acuminate and acute at the apex, dull on both sides or slightly lustrous above; venation pinnate with the midrib and main laterals distinct on both sides and more prominent below. Inflorescences at the nodes, a many-flowered spike; axis 15–80 mm long, with the flowers inserted in shallow hollows. Flowers probably functionaly unisexual but often with non-functional or vestigial organs of the other gender. Corolla in mature bud 6-merous, 3–4 mm long, widened upwards, clavate and rounded at the apex, white, yellow or orange. Stamens sometimes of unequal height; anther ca 1 mm long, obtuse, about equal to the free part of the filament.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Loranthus odoratus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 688. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Glabrous. Leaves opposite; lamina narrowly ovate to ovate, (3–)4–10(–13) by (1.2–)1.5 4(6)cm, cuneate to truncate at the base to a petiole 2–6 mm long, usually acuminate and acute or obtuse at the apex (but mostly rounded in specimens from Thailand), slightly lustrous or dull above, dull below; venation pinnate with the midrib distinct above and prominent below and the main laterals usually obscure on both sides. Inflorescences at the nodes, an umbel of usually 1 pair of flowers; axis 0.5–6 mm long, sometimes expanded at the apex into a membranous cup; pedicels 2–6 mm long; bracts triangular, acute, ca 1.5 mm long, free or connate only at the base and often spreading as a shallow dish. Corolla in mature bud 6 merous, 30–40 mm long, slender, weakly and unequally winged near the middle, usually curved in the upper part and weakly clavate and acute or obtuse at the apex, mostly red or rarely yellow or green, sometimes violet above; tube in the open flower 20–28 mm long, split more deeply on the concave side, with the lobes reflexed 3–4 mm higher. Anther ca 2 mm long, acute, about half as long as the free part of the filament.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Macrosolen avenis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 690. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Entirely glabrous. Leaves opposite or very slightly displaced; lamina lanceolate to narrowly elliptic or ovate, 8–14(–18) by 2.5–6(–8) cm, attenuate to cuneate at the base to a petiole 7–17 mm long, mostly acuminate and acute at the apex, slightly lustrous above, dull and slightly paler below; venation pinnate with the midrib distinct above and raised below and the main laterals faintly visible on both sides. Inflorescences arising from cup-like depressions at the nodes, 1–3 or rarely in each axil, a raceme of usually 2 or 3 (rarely 4–7) opposite pairs of flowers with the last two pairs subumbellate; axis robust, (3–)6–11 mm long, with 1 or 2 small triangular prophylls at or near the base; pedicels robust, 3–5 mm long; bracts 1.5–2 mm long, the central one triangular and the laterals slightly shorter, more rounded and distinctly connate. Corolla in mature bud 6-merous, 22–30 mm long, robust, gradually widened and inflated upwards, winged near the middle, narrowed above and angular, clavate and obtuse at the apex, mostly deep red; tube in the open flower broadly cylindric to almost campanulate, 10–14 mm long with the lobes reflexed 5–6 mm higher. Anther 3–4 mm long, acute, ⅓–⅔ as long as the free part of the filament.
creator: Rachun Pooma
