description: Glabrous or rarely the inflorescence shortly pale-tomentose. Leaves opposite or scattered, the normally developed ones sometimes alternating with cataphylls; lamina narrowly to broadly elliptic or ovate, 4–16 by 2–7 cm, cuneate to truncate at the base to a petiole (1–)3–10 mm long, usually acuminate and acute but sometimes obtuse or shortly rounded at the apex, lustrous above, dull below; venation pinnate with the midrib prominent and the main laterals faintly visible on both sides. Inflorescences at the nodes, a sometimes subumbellate or spicate raceme of 2–7 opposite pairs of flowers; axis slender, 5–20(–40) mm long, subtended at the base by an involucre of 1 or 2 pairs of small broadly triangular bracts; pedicels slender, 0–6 mm long; bracts 0.5–1 mm long, the central one triangular and the laterals slightly shorter and more rounded, not distinctly connate. Corolla in mature bud 6-merous, 8–18(–23) mm long, gradually widened or slightly inflated upwards, weakly winged near the middle, angular, clavate and obtuse or rarely acute at the apex, mostly yellow or green or rarely pink or red below, dark coloured at the neck and yellow or red above; tube in the open flower 5–10(–14) mm long with the lobes reflexed slightly higher. Anther 0.5–2 mm long, acute, about half to one third as long as the free part of the filament.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Macrosolen cochinchinensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 691. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Glabrous. Stem internodes distinctly quadrangular when young. Leaves opposite; lamina broadly ovate to cordate-orbicular, 7–19 by 5–13 cm, truncate to strongly cordate at the base, subsessile on a petiole 1–3 mm long, rounded at the apex, dull or slightly lustrous on either side; venation pinnate with the midrib and main laterals visible on both sides. Inflorescences at the nodes, a raceme or spike of (1–)2–5 opposite pairs of flowers; axis 4–14 mm long; pedicels 0–1 mm long; central bract orbicular, 2–2.5 mm long; lateral bracts 2–2.5 mm long, connate, together almost completely enclosing the ovary. Corolla in mature bud 6 merous, 70–125(–150) mm long, winged at about four fifths the length, clavate, often angular and truncate at the apex, red or yellow below, often yellow at the neck and red or green above; tube in the open flower 55–110 mm long with the lobes reflexed or twisted 5–10 mm higher. Anther 3–8 mm long, obtuse, about equal to the free part of the filament.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree (7–)10–30 m. Twigs towards apex 1.5–2.5(4) mm diam., glabrescent, hairs ca 0.1 mm; bark lower down dark grey-brown to blackish, coarsely striate, not or but rarely flaking; lenticels absent. Leaves blade chartaceous or thinly coriaceous, elliptic-oblong to oblong-lanceolate, 8–22 by 2–8 cm, base broadly acute or attenuate, apex acute(-acuminate); upper surface olivaceous, ± glossy, lower surface grey- or silvery-brown, sometimes tardily glabrescent, hairs dense, inconspicuous, ca 0.1 mm, with scattered brown hairs to ca 0.2 mm; not obviously papillose; dots absent; midrib flat above or somewhat raised, in a groove, lateral nerves 10–17 pairs, ± sunken, indistinct above, reticulation and marginal arches indistinct; petiole 12–22 by 1.5–3 mm; leaf bud 10–15 by 2–3 mm, hairs ca 0.1 mm. Inflorescences among the leaves, pedunculate, with mealy hairs, 0.1–0.2 mm; bracts ovate, 2–3 mm, caducous; in male: 1–2.5 cm long, peduncle 5–15 mm; lateral branches up to 5 mm, central axis to 10 mm or absent (or reduced to one flower), with subumbels of 5–8(–10) flowers, buds of different sizes; female inflorescence: an up to 3 mm pedunculate wart (rarely ± forked), with subumbel of 2–4 flowers. Flowers with hairs 0.1(–0.3) mm. Male flowers pedicel 3–6 by 0.5 mm, bracteole 1(–2) mm, (sub)apical, (tardily) caducous; bud ellipsoid-oblong, cylindrical or ± contracted in the middle, 5–7 by 2–3 mm, apex angled, lobes splitting the bud to ⅓–½ deep. Female slowers pedicel 2.5–4 mm; bud ovoid-ellipsoid, angled at apex, 5–6 by 2.5–3 mm, lobes splitting the bud to ⅓–½ deep. Infructescence 0.5–2 cm; fruits solitary or 2 (or 3), broadly ellipsoid or oblong, or ± pear-shaped, 5–9 by 2.5–5 cm, base rounded or subattenuate, hairs dense, mealy, rust-coloured, 0.1(–0.2) mm; stalk stoutish, 5–10 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Myristica cinnamomea. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 769. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree 6 40 m. Twigs towards apex 24 mm diam., yellowish on drying, soon glabrescent, at first with hairs 0.1–0.3 mm; bark lower down striate, not cracking. Leaves blade chartaceous, elliptic or oblong, 9–21(–32) by 3–9(–12) cm, glabrous (soon glabrescent), upper surface yellowish or olivaceous on drying; lower surface glabrescent (hairs flat, ca 0.1 mm or less); midvein slender, slightly raised above; nerves 8–13(–15) pairs, faint, slightly raised above; leaf bud with fine appressed hairs 0.1–0.3 mm. Inflorescences paniculate, with (sparse) appressed hairs ca 0.1 mm or less, ± glabrescent; male inflorescences 1–2.5 by 1–1.5 cm, few-flowered, peduncle 5–10(–12) mm long; female inflorescences as the males but (much) reduced. Mature buds in both sexes angular in the upper portion, thinly pubescent with hairs ca 0.1 mm. Male flowers pedicel 3–5 mm long, bracteole (sub)apical, 0.5–1 mm long; bud elliptic-oblong, sometimes contracted below the lobes, 7–8(–9) by 2.5–3.5 mm, apex acute, lobes splitting the bud to ca ⅓ deep. Female flowers pedicel ca 3 mm long, bud ovoid oblong, 6–8 by 3–4 mm. Fruits ovoid or ellipsoid(-oblong), base often narrowed into a pseudostalk 4–12 mm long, 4.5–7.5 by (2–)2.5–4.0 cm, glabrescent, hairs ca 0.1 mm, dark brown on drying; stalk slender, 5–10 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Myristica elliptica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 770. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree 4–10 m. Twigs slender, towards apex 1–2 mm diam., yellowish, glabrescent, at first with hairs 0.1 mm or less; bark lower down not cracking. Leaves blade chartaceous or thin-coriaceous, (ovate-)elliptic or oblong, 6–13 by 3.5–6.5 cm, upper surface olivaceous on drying, lower soon glabrescent (hairs ± 0.1 mm); midvein slender, raised above; nerves 6–12 pairs, flat or sunken above; petiole slender; leaf bud with hairs ca 0.1 mm or less. Inflorescences essentially paniculate, in male slender, with slender peduncle 5–20 mm long, with one or two remotely scar-covered branches terminally with up to 5 flowers, sometimes inflorescence reduced to 1–3 almost sessile flowers; female inflorescences 1(–3)-flowered. Flowers fragrant. Male flowers pedicel slender, 10–15 mm long, bracteole caducous; bud (ellipsoid-) oblong, 7–8 by 4–5 mm, not angular, lobes splitting the bud to ca ⅕ deep. Female flowers stouter than male flowers, pedicel 8–12 mm long. Fruit solitary, pendent, broadly pear-shaped or almost globose, when dry 4–6 cm long (6–9 cm diam, when fresh), with hairs ca 0.1 mm, glabrescent; stalk 10–15 mm, somewhat widening towards the fruit.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Myristica guatteriifolia is a widespread species of West Malesia according to Sinclair (l.c.) occurring in Malaya only in the east coast area and only known from continental SE Asia by collections from Condor I. (S Vietnam) and from SE Myanmar, Shan States, close to N Thailand. I have not seen this latter material.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree 5–40 m. Twigs towards apex slender, 1.5–3 mm diam., glabrous or soon glabrescent (hairs less than 0.1 mm); bark lower down striate, then longitudinally cracking. Leaves blade membranous to chartaceous, elliptic-oblong or oblong-lanceolate, 7–24 by 1.5–8(–10) cm, upper surface olivaceous on drying, lower surface glabrous or soon glabrescent (hairs less than 0.1 mm); midvein slender, raised above; nerves 11–16 pairs, above flat or sunken; petiole slender; leaf bud with hairs 0.2(–0.5) mm. Male inflorescences paniculate, 2–8 cm long, peduncle 2–30(–40) mm long; flowers in sub-umbels of 5–15; female inflorescences reduced, 1–6-flowered. Flowers membranous, with hairs 0.1–0.3 mm, glabrescent. Male flowers pedicel slender, 4–12 mm, bracteole pubescent, 1.5–3 mm long, subpersistent or caducous; bud ovoid (-ellipsoid), at apex not angular, 4–6(–7) by 2–4(–6) mm, lobes splitting the bud to (¼–)⅓–½ deep. Female flowers pedicel 1–7 mm; bud broadly ovoid, 44.5 by 3, 5 4 mm. Fruits (ovoid-)ellipsoid, 3.5–6(–8) by 2.5–3.5(–4, 5) cm, mealy pubescent with hairs ca 0.2 mm, usually soon glabrescent; stalk 1–3(–5) mm.

description: Tree 10 40 m. Twigs towards apex (2–)2.5–4 mm diam., with shaggy hairs 0.2–0.5 mm; bark lower down blackish, often coarsely flaking. Leaves blade chartaceous or (thin-) coriaceous, elliptic-oblong to oblong-lanceolate, 12–25(–28) by 4–7(–8.5) cm, upper surface olivaceous on drying, lower surface soon glabrescent, hairs 0.1–0.3 mm, papillose; midvein raised above; nerves 13–18(–20) pairs, sunken above; leaf bud with shaggy or appressed hairs 0.5–1(–1.5) mm. Inflorescences short-paniculate, shaggy rusty pubescent with hairs 1(–1.5) mm; in male 1.5–2 by 1.5–2 cm, peduncle 5–12 mm long; flowers in subumbels of 5–15(–20); female inflorescences shorter than male, with flowers in clusters of 1–4. Flowers with hairs 0.5–1 mm. Male flowers pedicel 5–6(–9) mm, bracteole 3–5 mm long, subpersistent; bud ovoid-ellipsoid, 6–7 by 4.5–5 mm, lobes splitting bud to ⅕–¼ deep. Female flowers pedicel ca 3 mm, bud ovoid(-ellipsoid), ca 6 by 4.5 mm. Fruits broadly ovoid-ellipsoid, 7–9 by 5–6 cm, glabrescent, at first with a mealy tomentum of hairs ca 0.5 mm; stalk short, stout, 6–11 mm long.

description: Tree 15–35 m. Twigs robust, towards apex (4–)5–8 mm diam., soon glabrescent, at first with very minute tomentum, blackish brown on drying; bark lower down not distinctly cracking. Leaves blade chartaceous (to thin-coriaceous), elliptic to oblong-lanceolate, 16–40 by (6–)10–20 cm, upper surface (blackish) brown, sometimes slightly bullate, lower surface brownish grey, glabrescent, at first with scale-like hairs 0.1(–0.2) mm or less; midvein flat or raised above; nerves 23–33 pairs, impressed above, reticulation and marginal arches usually distinct; petiole stout; leaf bud with hairs ca 0.1 mm or less. Inflorescences subglabrescent, paniculate, the peduncle stout, flattened; male inflorescences stout, paniculate, 6–12(–18) by 3–8 cm, peduncle 20–45 mm long; flowers in subumbels of 5–10; female inflorescences smaller, 5_9 cm long. Flowers coriaceous, thinly pubescent with hairs less than 0.1 mm; bracteole persistent. Male flowers pedicel 3–10 mm long, bracteole 1.5–2 mm long with finely ciliate margin; bud ovoid(-ellipsoid), with rounded apex, 5–7 by 4–5 mm, lobes splitting the bud to ca halfway or more. Female flowers pedicel 1–3(–4) mm long; bud coriaceous, ovoid, 5–7 by 4–6 mm. Fruits ellipsoid-oblong, apex and base rounded or base slightly narrowed, (4.5–)6–9 by 3.5–5 cm, mealy pubescent with hairs 0.1 mm or less, tardily glabrescent; stalk stout, 3–10 mm long.

description: Tree 8–20 m. Twigs towards apex 3–5 mm diam., glabrescent, hairs ca 0.1 mm; bark lower down bright (grey-) brown, striate, not flaking. Leaves: blade membranous, elliptic oblong, 25–40 by 9–14 cm; upper surface greenish brown, lower surface grey cinnamon, with very dense scale-like hairs ca 0.1 mm; not papillose; dots absent; midrib flat above, nerves 20–25 pairs, flat, reticulation and marginal arches faint; petiole 20–25 by 3–4 mm; leaf bud ca 20 by 4 mm, hairs ca 0.1 mm. Inflorescences in male: paniculate, in among the leaves; hairs ca 0.1 mm; peduncle 10–15 mm long, branches few, to 5 mm long, flowers solitary or 3 (–5-)clustered, buds of variable sizes. Male flowers: pedicel ca 4 mm; bracteole ca 4 mm; buds ovoid-oblong, ca 6 by 4(–4.5) mm, lobes splitting the bud to ca ⅓ deep. Female flowers not known. Infructescence short; fruit mostly solitary(±), ellipsoid(-oblong), 6–6.5 by 3.5–4 cm, hairs dense, shaggy, ca 1 mm long; dry pericarp ca 5 mm thick; seed 4.5 cm long; stalk short.

description: Indumentum dense, of peltate, stipitate, disc-shaped unicellular scales each with 4-8 scattered tooth-like processes, mixed with scattered dendritic hairs, disappearing with age from stems and leaf upper surfaces. Stem internodes distinctly flattened and double-edged in the upper part when young, striate; prophylls and cataphylls narrow, acute, ca 0.7 mm long. Leaf lamina elliptic to orbicular, 2–4 by 2–3 cm, attenuate or cuneate at the base to a petiole 2–5 mm long, rounded at the apex. Inflorescence a single pedunculate cymule of ca 7 flowers with the central 1–3 flowers male; peduncle ca 2 mm long, elongating up to 6 mm long in fruit. Fruit narrowly ellipsoid.

description: Herb up to 70 cm; stem erect, glabrous at base, in distal part sparsely brownish glandu lar hairy. Leaves reddish, oblong-linear, 5–9 by 0.5–1 cm, sessile or shortly petiolate, margin serrulate, glabrous on both sides; lateral nerves ca 12, arched, confluent to a marginal vein. Inflorescence 5–7 cm long, brown glandular hairy; pedicels 2–3 mm. Flowers yellowish. Sepals 5, triangular, 2–3 mm, connate at base; petals wanting or 5 minute; stamens 10(–12), filaments ca 3 mm; anthers oblong, ca 2 mm. Ovary 3–4 mm high. Follicle 4–5 mm high, 8–10 mm across. Seeds ovate-oblong.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree or large shrub to 9 m, Outer bark, smooth light grey-green-brown, soon peeling or flaking, inner bark light-brown, twigs sharply 4-angled, often pubescent, glandular. Leaves elliptical to ovate, 8–14 by 4–6 cm, acute or obtuse, midrib impressed on upper surface, with an incomplete intramarginal vein ca 0.75 mm from margin, upper surface drying light grey brown, glabrous, lower surface drying darker brown and pubescent, both surfaces dotted with minute glands, veins impressed. Petioles very short, pubescent or absent. Flowers mostly solitary or in clusters, axillary. Bracteoles filiform, ca 4 mm, deciduous. Pedicels 20–25 mm, glandular punctate, pubescent. Calyx infundibuliform, eglandular, 6 mm, puberulent; lobes obtuse ca 2 mm. Pseudostipe absent. Petals white, ca 12 mm long, puberulent. Stamens numerous; filaments glabrous ca 10 mm long, connective with a very small apical gland. Style 10 mm; stigma capitate. Hypanthium shallowly cup-shaped, glabrous. Fruits 1–6 cm long, globose or pyriform, yellow. Seeds strongly folded, the radicle included in a cotyledon.

description: Shrub to 4 m. Otherwise resembling P. guajava but with usually larger up to 14 by 7 cm, glabrous leaves with the veins elevated and prominent above, terete or sub-terete twigs, minute deciduous, ovate bracteoles, smaller petals (–5 mm) and a shorter style (–5 mm). Fruits yellow or more commonly dark purple.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Psidium littorale. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 7. Part 4, 2002. Pg. 804. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Shrub or small tree normally less than 10 m (–17 m in Malay Peninsula). Outer bark black, brown or greyish-green, young twigs usually grey, inner bark white yellow. Twigs pubescent. Leaves ovate to elliptic, 6–15 by 3–6 cm; apex acuminate, with evenly sized, very small glands (< 0.1 mm) (bright light needed); upper surface dark brown on drying, more or less glabrous, veins obscure, midvein impressed; lower surface light grey-green on drying, more or less sericeous, primary veins almost glabrous, prominent, raised, intramarginal vein <0.5 mm from leaf-margin. Petioles ca 5 mm, pubescent. Flowers axillary, in clusters or dichasia. Peduncles usually < 5 mm or absent. Pseudostipe absent. Pedicels up to 10 mm slender, sericeous. Calyx sericeous, campanulate ca 4 mm; lobes obtuse ca 1.5 mm. Petals sericeous, ca 4 mm long, white-yellow. Stamens numerous. Style ca 3 mm. Hypanthium shallowly cup-shaped, weakly tomentose. Fruits green, red or purple. Seeds <5 mm, angular.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Leaves green on both surfaces.

description: Shrub or small tree normally less than 5 m. Outer bark brown, young twigs usually grey. Twigs sericeous. Leaves ovate to elliptic; 6–9 by 2–3 cm; triveined or tripliveined, intramarginal vein often inconspicuous; apex long acuminate; usually with both very small(< 0.05 mm) and larger (ca. 0.1 mm) glands (bright light needed); upper surface dark brown on drying, glabrous or sericeous, secondary veins obscure, almost glabrous; lower surface light brown on drying, more or less sericeous, intramarginal vein > 0.5 mm from leaf-margin. Petioles ca 5 mm, pubescent. Flowers axillary, solitary or in clusters or dichasia. Peduncles usually < 10 mm or absent. Pedicels up to 10 mm slender, sericeous. Calyx sericeous; campanulate ca 4 mm; lobes obtuse ca 1.5 mm. Pseudostipe 2 mm or absent. Petals sericeous, 5–8 mm long, white-yellow, or pink. Stamens numerous. Style ca 3 mm, stigma obscure. Hypanthium shallowly cup-shaped, weakly tomentose. Fruit green, red or purple, 6–8 mm. Seeds ca 4 mm, angular.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Small shrub to 2 m. Outer bark light brown, soon flaking. Leaves ovate to elliptic; 2–3 by 1.1–2 cm; triveined with a faint intramarginal vein hidden by the revolute margin; apex acute; glandular; coriaceous; upper surface dark brown on drying, more or less glabrous, veins often slightly impressed, obscure, sometimes pubescent at the base; lower surface dark ocherous on drying, tomentose, primary veins raised. Petioles absent or very short. Flowers axillary, nearly always in pairs. Pedicels 1–1.5 cm, tomentose. Pseudostipe present, ca 2 mm. Calyx infundibuliform, ca 5 mm; lobes obtuse ca 2 mm, lobes sub-equal, densely golden-yellow tomentose. Petals cream, white-tomentose on outside, ca 6 mm long. Stamens numerous, filaments ca 4 mm long, connective with a minute apical gland. Style ca 4 mm, pink at base. Hypanthium shallowly cup-shaped or flat, hoary, deepening in fruit. Fruit a dark brown/black berry, minutely hairy, topped by persistent calyx-lobes. Seeds (1–)2, smooth globular or hemispherical with one face angular, 4 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Shrub or small tree less than 4 m. Outer bark light brown soon flaking or peeling to reveal orangish-red underbark. Twigs dark brown tomentose when mature. Leaves ovate to elliptic; 2–10 by 1.5–4 cm; tripliveined with an intramarginal vein; margin sub-revolute; apex obtuse, acute or apiculate; glandular (bright light needed); upper surface dark brown on drying, more or less glabrous, veins often slightly impressed, obscure, sometimes white pubescent at the base; lower surface ocherous on drying, tomentose, sub-hispid with scattered dark brown hairs (especially on the veins), primary veins raised. Petioles ca 5 mm, angled, tomentose. Flowers axillary or terminal, solitary or in dichasia. Peduncles 1–2 cm densely tomentose and sub-hispid. Pedicels up to 1.5 cm, tomentose. Pseudostipe present, 4–8 mm. Calyx infundibuliform, ca 10 mm; lobes obtuse ca 6 mm, inner 2 lobes longer than outer 3, densely tomentose. Petals pink, white-tomentose on outside, 1.5–2 cm long. Stamens numerous, filaments 10 mm long, connective with a minute apical gland. Style ca 1.5 cm. Hypanthium shallowly cup-shaped or flat, hoary. Fruit ca 9 by 10 mm, green, red or purple, densely tomentose. Seeds 2 mm by 3 mm, light brown, tuberculate, reniform.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Herb up to 20 cm. Stems thin, branched, densely covered by long, white hairs in distal part also glandular hairy. Leaves along the stem or sometimes crowded rosette-like towards apex, sessile, lanceolate, 10–21 by 2–7 mm, apex acute, margin with regularly spaced stiff hairs; upper surface with scattered stiff hairs, lower surface pale, glabrous, all leaves may carry leafy buds in the axils. Inflorescence terminal, subtended by a bract similar to the leaves but smaller, mostly a short cyme with up to 7 flowers, sometimes only one flower. Axis up to 7 cm, densely glandular hairy. Sepals 5, lanceolate, ca 3 mm long with 3 veins and a scarious margin; petals 5, white in distal part, green with yellow or purple spots at base, 6–7 mm long, lanceolate with a short claw, 3–5-nerved; stamens 10 or fewer, filaments filiform, ca 5 mm long, anthers ellipsoid. Ovary semi-inferior, ovoid ca 3 mm. Capsule ca 5 mm long from base to tip of the 2 divergent, persistent styles.

description: Young parts with a dense cream or rarely greyish to dark ochre indumentum of stellate hairs, becoming sparse on adult stems, leaf upper surfaces and flowers. Leaves opposite; lamina elliptic to obovate, 5–10 by 2.3–6 cm, cuneate to slightly cordate at the base to a petiole 6–12 mm long, usually rounded at the apex; venation obscure except for the midrib and a few major laterals visible above. Inflorescences several at the nodes, a (2–)4- to 6(–10)-flowered raceme; axis 4–12(–21) mm long; pedicels 2–3 mm long; bract deltoid, erect, ca 1.5 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 11–22(–24) mm long, slender, narrowly clavate and acute at the apex; tube 7–15 mm long, deeply split. Anther ca 1 mm long, about half as long as the free part of the filament. Fruit 8–9 mm long including a thick stipe 2–3 mm long, contracted at the apex.

description: Young parts with a dense ochre to reddish brown indumentum of short stellate hairs and longer dendritic hairs, becoming sparse on adult stems and leaf upper surfaces. Leaves opposite; lamina elliptic to ovate or slightly obovate, (3–)5–10 by (1.5–)2–5.5 cm, cuneate to weakly cordate at the base to a petiole 2–6(–10) mm long, obtuse or rounded at the apex; venation obscure except for the midrib and a few major laterals visible above. Inflorescences several at the nodes, a 2- to 5-flowered raceme; axis 2–10(–15) mm long; pedicels 0.5–2.5(–4) mm long; bract narrow, erect, 1–2(–3) mm long. Corolla in mature bud (6–)8–14(–23) mm long, slightly curved or almost straight, usually robust or rarely relatively slender, weakly clavate, obtuse to truncate at the apex; tube 5–15 mm long, split to the middle or lower. Anther 0.5–1 mm long, about half as long as the free part of the filament. Fruit 8–10 mm long including a stipe 4–6 mm long, rounded at the apex.

description: Young parts with a greyish or sometimes tawny to light brown tomentum, soon disappearing from the stems and leaves but persisting sparsely on the inflorescences and flowers. Leaves opposite; lamina elliptic-ovate or more commonly obovate, 4–8(–10) by 1.5–3(–5) cm, shortly cuneate to slightly cordate at the base to a petiole 6–12 mm long, obtuse to rounded at the apex; venation obscure except for the midrib and a few major laterals visible on both sides. Inflorescences few at the nodes, a 2- to 6-flowered raceme; axis up to 6 mm long; pedicels 1–3 mm long; bract ovate, 0.5–1 mm long. Anther 1.2–3 mm long, about equal to the free part of the filament. Fruit 8–11 mm long including a stipe 5–7 mm long, rounded at the apex.

description: Young parts with a dense ochre to reddish brown indumentum of short stellate hairs, often with some longer dendritic ones disappearing sooner, becoming sparse on adult stems, leaves and corollas. Leaves opposite; lamina narrowly elliptic to ovate or obovate, (3.5–)6–12(–15) by (1.8–)3–5.5 cm, shortly cuneate to weakly cordate at the base to a petiole (3–)6–10(–15)mm long, obtuse or rounded at the apex; venation obscure except for the midrib and a few major laterals visible on both sides. Inflorescences several at the nodes, a (2–)4- to 8-flowered raceme; axis (2–)12–25(–30) mm long; pedicels (1–)4–7 mm long; bract elliptic, erect, variable, (0.5–)1–1.5(–3) mm long. Corolla in mature bud 19–45 mm long, rarely slightly shorter, usually slender, clavate, angular and acute at the apex; tube 13–30 mm long, sometimes slightly inflated, split to the middle or lower. Anther 1–2(–4) mm long, usually about two thirds as long as the free part of the filament. Fruit 8–12 mm long including a stipe 5–7 mm long, rounded at the apex.

description: Young parts with a sparse to dense grey to dark brown or rarely paler indumentum of short stellate hairs, soon becoming sparse on adult stems and leaves. Leaves opposite; lamina narrowly ovate to obovate, 3–7(–9) by 1.5–3.5(–4.5) cm, thin, cuneate to truncate at the base to a petiole 3–10 mm long, acute obtuse or rounded at the apex; venation obscure except for the midrib and a few major laterals visible on both sides. description: Young parts with a floccose white to cream tomentum, soon disappearing from stems and leaves but persisting as a floccose to scurfy covering on the inflorescences, flowers and fruits. Leaves opposite or slightly displaced; lamina broadly oblong to ovate, variable in size, (5–)10–15(–20) by (3–)6–9(–15) cm, shortly cuneate or truncate at the base to a distinct petiole (8–)12–25 mm long, thickly coriaceous, acute or obtuse at the apex; venation distinct on both sides, slightly curvinerved. Inflorescences solitary to several at the nodes, a few-flowered raceme; axis 12–25(–60) mm long; pedicels 6–8 mm long; bract very small, ovate. Corolla in mature bud (25–)30–45 mm long, slender, curved, weakly clavate and acute at the apex, green beneath the indumentum; tube in the open flower (15–)20–30 mm long, slender, deeply split. Anther and filament dimensions not known. Fruit “large, club-shaped” (according to Kurz); dimensions not known.

description: Young parts with a thick, dense, off-white tomentum, soon disappearing from adult stems and leaf upper surfaces, and becoming sparser on leaf lower surfaces, inflorescences, flowers and fruits. Leaves opposite; lamina oblanceolate, to 4.5 by 1 cm (in Thailand), attenuate at the base to a petiole ca 5 mm long, blunt to rounded at the apex; venation faintly visible except for the distinct midrib. Inflorescences few at the nodes, a 2-flowered raceme (in Thailand); peduncle 0.5–1.5 mm long; pedicels thinner, 2–3 mm long (in fruit); bract narrow, erect, acute, 1–1.5 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 12–18 mm long, slender (according to Kurz). Fruit 8–12 mm long including a stipe 5–8 mm long, with a small annular thickening at the base, rounded at the apex, crowned by an erect, weakly toothed calyx limb.

description: Small tree, height unknown. Twigs terete (the young twigs 4-angled and winged), the bark brownish or whitish grey. Leaves with petiole 1.7–3, 5 mm; lamina 3.5–4.5 by 1–2 cm, narrowly lanceolate or oblong lanceolate, sometimes oblanceolate, base acute, apex acute or attenuate-obtuse; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 11–12 pairs, inconspicuous, intramarginal vein 1. Inflorescence up to 2.5 cm, both terminal and axillary, corymbose, with 6–9 flowers; peduncle up to 2 mm; bracts 1.4 by 0.8 mm, triangular, oblong or elliptic. Flowers sessile, solitary or in groups at the branchlet ends. Hypanthial cup 10–12 mm, narrowly clavate or narrowly funnel-shaped. Pseudostipe 7 mm. Sepals 5, 0.7–0.8 mm, triangular or semiorbicular. Petals 5, 1.9 4.4 mm, pseudo-calyptrate, orbicular, 30–70 gland dots per petal. Outer stamens 8.1–11.3 mm; anther 0.5 mm, oblong. Style 10–10.5 mm. Ovary 2-locular, only one locule fertile, ca 17 ovules per locule. Fruits unknown.

description: Tree to 8 m. Twigs slender, undulate, 4-angled, winged and ending in auricles at nodes, the bark pale brown. Leaves with petiole transversely corrugated, 1.9–3.5 mm; lamina 7.3–10.6 by 2.2–2.5 cm, oblong or oblong lanceolate, base rounded, apex long acuminate; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 10–13 pairs, intramarginal veins 2. Inflorescence 1.5 4.5 cm, both terminal and axillary, with 4–15 flowers, young inflorescence covered with membranous bracts; peduncle 10–37 mm, angled and winged; the lower bracts at the peduncle base 4.5 by 1.4 mm, lanceolate or triangular, rigid, the upper bracts 2.8–4.9 by 3.1–3.7 mm, variable in shape, elliptic or triangular. Flowers white, sessile. Hypanthial cup 5.6–6 mm, narrowly funnel-shaped, longitudinally wrinkled. Pseudostipe 1–2 mm. Sepals 4–6, 1–2.9 mm, elliptic, rather membranous, 5–10 gland dots per lobe. Petals 46, 1.7–2.6 mm, pseudo-calyptrate, orbicular, membranous, 16–19 gland dots per petal. Outer stamens 7–7.6 mm; anther ca 0.2 mm, elliptic oblong. Style 8.3–8.8 mm. Ovary 2-locular, 11–14 ovules per locule. Fruits unknown.

description: Tree to 15 m. Twigs terete, the bark striate or flaky, reddish brown or whitish grey. Leaves with petiole 4–10 mm; lamina (6–)7–14.1 by 3–6 cm, ovate, obovate, oblong-ovate or lanceolate, base narrowly or broadly cuneate, apex acute or acuminate, sometimes obtuse; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 7–13 pairs, intramarginal vein 1 or absent. Inflorescence 3–6 mm, both terminal and in the upper axils, paniculate, usually with several branches from the base, sometimes solitary; peduncle up to 15 mm, rachis and branches striate. Flowers white or pale yellow, usually in threes at branchlet ends, outer flowers pedicelled, central flower sessile; pedicel 2–5 mm. Hypanthial cup 6–8.5 mm, funnel-shaped. Pseudostipe 2.5–4.5 mm. Sepals 4, 1.2–2.2 mm, semiorbicular. Petals 4, 4.2–7.4 mm, free, orbicular, 70–100 gland dots per petal. Outer stamens 7–12.6 mm; anther 0.5 mm, oblong ovate. Style 8.6–15 mm. Ovary 2-locular, 16–23 ovules per locule. Fruits white, globose, 1.5 cm diam., 1-seeded.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Tree to 15 m. Twigs compressed, the bark dark brown or whitish grey. Leaves with petiole thick, corky, 4.3–9.1 mm; lamina 21.2–26.4 by 7.3–8 cm, narrowly oblong, oblong or elliptic, base cordate or auriculate-cordate, apex obtuse; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 13–14 pairs, intramarginal veins 2. Outer stamens 2.4–2.8 mm, anther 0.8 mm. Style ca 3.8 mm. Ovary 2-locular, 12–15 ovules per locule. Fruits unknown.

description: Tree to 20 m. Twigs terete, the bark brownish grey. Leaves with petiole 3–5 mm; lamina 5.2–6.7 by 1.4–4.3 cm, ovate, elliptic or lanceolate, base cuneate or acute, apex caudate acuminate; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 7–10 pairs, intramarginal vein 1. Inflorescence up to 6 cm, both terminal and axillary, lax; peduncle, rachis and branches terete. Flowers white; pedicel to 50 mm, not filiform. Hypanthial cup 4.1–4.4 mm; funnel shaped. Pseudostipe ca 0.7 mm. Sepals 4, 0.8–0.9 mm, triangular. Petals 4, 2.9–3.6 mm, free, orbicular, 27–35 gland dots per petal. Outer stamens 4.7–6 mm; anther 0.5 mm, oblong. Style 5.2–6.5 mm. Ovary 2-locular, 7–10 ovules per locule. Fruits (immature) oblong.

description: Tree to 8 m. Twigs 4-angled, winged, the bark brownish. Leaves with petiole 3.5–7 mm, lamina 6.3–13.7 by 1.4–3 cm, narrowly oblong or oblong elliptic or linear, base cuneate, apex obtuse-acuminate; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 15–20 pairs, intramarginal veins 2. Inflorescence up to 9 cm, both terminal and axillary; peduncle up to 18 mm, rachis and branches 4-angled, winged. Flowers white, or yellowish white, sessile. Hypanthial cup 3.5–5.3 mm, funnel-shaped. Pseudostipe 1–1.5 mm. Sepals 4, 0.3–0.7 mm, triangular. Petals 4, 1.9–2.7 mm, pseudo-calyptrate, orbicular, membranous, 5–10 gland dots per petal. Outer stamens 3.5–4.2 mm; anther 0.4 mm, ovate. Style 4.5–6.3 mm. Ovary 2 locular, 3–5 ovules per locule. Fruits unknown.

description: Tree to 15 m. Twigs angled, the bark pale brown or reddish brown. Leaves with petiole 1.1–7 mm, lamina 3.4–9.8 by 1.1–3.2 cm, ovate, lanceolate or elliptic, base broadly cuneate or rounded, apex acute or acuminate; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 10–14 pairs, intramarginal vein 1. Inflorescence up to 3 cm, both terminal and axillary, cymose, several together; branches and branchlets angled or slightly winged. Flowers white, sessile. Hypanthial cup 5–6.5 mm, cylindrical funnel-shaped; pustulate. Pseudostipe 1–2 mm. Sepals 4–5, 0.6–1.5 mm. Petals 5, (1.4–) 2.1–2.8 mm, pseudo-calyptrate, orbicular, membranous, 30–50 gland dots per petal. Outer stamens (3.9–)8.4–11.7 mm; anther 0.4 mm, oblong. Style (4.2–)8.5–12.3 mm. Ovary 2-locular, 7–12 ovules per locule. Fruits whitish globose.

description: Tree to 20 m. Twigs terete, the bark whitish grey. Leaves with petiole 7–21 mm, lamina 6.3–13 by 2–5.8 cm, ovate, oblanceolate or oblong lanceolate, base broadly cuneate or attenuate, decurrent, apex broadly acute, acuminate or obtuse; midrib impressed on the upper surface, secondary veins 6–9 pairs, intramarginal vein absent. Inflorescence 4–8 cm, both terminal and in the upper axils, paniculate, branched from the base; branches and branchlets terete, angled or compressed. Flowers white, sessile, sometimes pedicelled. Hypanthial cup 7–8.4 mm, funnel-shaped. Pseudostipe 3 mm. Sepals 4, 1.8–4.5 by 4 mm, orbicular or triangular. Petals 4, 5.1–8.5 mm, free, orbicular, >100 gland dots per petal. Outer stamens 9.1–13.6 mm; anther 0.7–0.8 mm, linear oblong. Style 8.4–13.3 mm. Ovary 2-locular, 15–34 ovules per locule. Fruits unknown.

description: Young parts with a dense grey to dark brown or rarely paler indumentum of short stellate hairs, soon becoming sparse on adult stems and leaves and eventually on inflorescences and flowers. Leaves opposite; lamina elliptic to ovate, 2–4.5 by 1.5–3 cm, thin, cuneate at the base to a petiole 4–7 mm long, obtuse or rounded at the apex, dull on both sides or glossy above; venation pinnate with the midrib and major laterals visible above and prominent below. Inflorescences at the nodes, a 2-flowered umbel; peduncle (0.5–)1–6 mm long; pedicels 4–10 mm long; bract ovate, acute, 0.5–1 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 4-merous, (14–)22–32 mm long, slightly inflated at the base, slender above, strongly clavate and obtuse at the apex, greenish, often tinged yellow or brown, the colour somewhat obscured by the indumentum; tube (10–)15–22 mm long, split to the middle. Anther 1.5–2 mm long, about twice as long as the free part of the filament. Fruit 6–8 mm long, narrowly ellipsoid, warty, crowned by a collar ca 1 mm long.

description: Young parts with a thick, dense, ochre to rusty, layered indumentum of stellate and dendritic hairs, becoming sparse on most vegetative parts but persisting on leaf undersides, petiole and adjacent midrib, inflorescences and flowers. Leaves alternate, opposite or scattered; lamina oblong to orbicular, 5–7 by 3–4 cm, thin, obtuse or rounded at the base to a petiole 5–10 mm long, obtuse to rounded at the apex, dull on both sides; venation pinnate with the midrib and major laterals visible. Inflorescences crowded at the nodes, a 3- to 5-flowered umbel (often slightly racemose through unequal development and attachment of the flowers); peduncle 2–3 mm long; pedicels 1.5–2.5 mm long; bract deltoid, acute, concave, ca 1 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 5- or 4-merous (4-merous in Thailand), 12–15(–17) mm long, inflated at the base, slender above, strongly clavate and acute at the apex, dull pink below, greenish above, the colour somewhat obscured by the indumentum; tube 7–10 mm long, split to the middle. Anther ca 1 mm long, about one third to one half as long as the free part of the filament. Fruit ca 8 mm long, ellipsoid or slightly ovoid, crowned by a collar ca 1 mm long.

description: Young parts with a rather thin dark ferruginous indumentum, soon becoming sparse on adult stems and leaves but persisting sparsely on inflorescences, flowers and fruits. Leaves opposite or subopposite; lamina ovate-oblong to lanceolate, 4–7 by 1.5–3.5 cm, contracted at the base to a petiole 5–12 mm long, obtuse at the apex, revolute at the margin, glossy above, dull below; venation pinnate with the midrib and major laterals visible above and the midrib prominent below. Inflorescences at the nodes, a 3- to 6-flowered umbel; peduncle 3–5 mm long; pedicels 3–5 mm long; bract ovate, ca 1 mm long. Corolla in mature bud 4-merous, 27–35 mm long, slightly inflated at the base, slender above, curved, clavate and obtuse at the apex; tube 18–27 mm long, split to below the middle. Anther 3–5 mm long, about 2.5 times as long as the free part of the filament. Fruit ellipsoid, 7–8 mm long, warty.

description: Young vegetative parts, inflorescences and flowers with a long, dense, villous, layered, ochre to brown indumentum of stellate and long barbed dendritic hairs, eventually disappearing from the stems and laminas but persisting on the petioles and inflorescence parts. Leaves alternate or (usually in Thailand) opposite or scattered; lamina broadly ovate to suborbicular, 3–7 by (1.5–)2–6 cm, truncate to slightly cordate at the base to a distinct petiole 3–8 mm long, thin, obtuse or rounded at the apex, dull on both sides or slightly lustrous above; venation pinnate with the midrib and major laterals faintly to clearly visible above and distinct (or obscured by persistent indumentum) below. Inflorescences several in the axils and at leafless nodes, a shortly pedunculate umbel of 2–4 flowers, peduncle 1–5 mm long; pedicels 2–5 mm long; bract orbicular, concave, as long as and clasping the ovary, 2.5–3 mm long or sometimes (apparently not in Thailand) longer and foliose. Corolla in mature bud 4- or 5-merous, (10–)13–18 mm long, cylindric, slightly inflated to the middle, truncate at the apex, green beneath the indumentum; tube in the open flower (7–)9–12 mm long, slit on one side to about half its length. Anther curved, blunt, 1–2 mm long, longer than the free part of the filament. Fruit narrowly ovoid, not seen mature.

description: Shrub or tree to 9 m. Outer bark light grey-brown to beige, soon flaking, bark of young twigs black. Leaves ovate or elliptic, 3–10 by 1–3, 5 cm, usually acute sometimes obtuse, margin revolute, with 10–20 obscure secondary veins and a faint intramarginal vein < 1 mm from margin, main vein often abaxially sericeous at the base, leaves glabrous or hairy never rufus. Petioles 5–15 mm, young often densely sericeous. Flowers 5-merous, axillary, in clusters. Bracieoles lanceolate, ca 2 mm long, deciduous. Pedicels 2–4 mm. Calyx infundibuliform, almost glabrous or densely white sericeous, 34 mm, lobes 1 mm, yellow green. Pseudostipe absent. Petals white, ca 2, 5 mm long. Stamens numerous, grouped in 5 antipetalous fascicles each of 4–9 stamens, filaments weakly pubescent at base, longest ca 2, 5 mm, connective with a small apical gland. Style < 1 mm. Ovary half-inferior, the top weakly sericeous; stigma truncate. Fruit ca 5 mm. Seeds ca 4 by 1.5 mm, wing minutely rugulose.

description: This differs from the type variety in its leaves which have a dense rufus indumentum of short crisped hairs sometimes with scattered dark brown hairs and longer pale hairs.

description: Tree to 12 m. Outer bark light brown, soon flaking, inner bark light brown. Leaves lanceolate, ovate, obovate, 3–9 by 2–4 cm, acute or obtuse, coriaceous, margins revolute, midrib impressed on upper surface, with a faint intramarginal vein ca 0.5 mm from margin, upper surface drying dark brown, lower surface drying light brown and sometimes gland dotted, both glabrous. Petioles 2 mm, puberulent or absent. Flowers solitary or in clusters, axillary. Bracteoles lanceolate, ca 4 mm, deciduous. Pedicels minute or absent. Calyx infundibuliform, eglandular, 6 mm, puberulent, lobes obtuse ca 1 mm. Pseudostipe ca 1 mm. Petals white, ca 2 mm long, puberulent. Stamens numerous, grouped in 5 antipetalous fascicles, each of 10–15 stamens, filaments pubescent at base, longest filaments ca 2.5 mm, connective with a small apical gland. Style 2 mm. Ovary half-inferior, top pubescent, stigma capitate. Fruits ca 12 mm. Seeds 9 mm by 4 mm, minutely rugose.

description: Plant slender, pendulous. Stem internodes at maturity decussately flattened or compressed, quadrangular or double-edged with a raised angular rib on each face, 15–50 mm long, 1–3 mm wide below, widened to 2–5 mm above. Leaves rudimentary, spreading, ca 0.5 mm long. Inflorescence axillary, a sessile cymule of 3 flowers subtended by a cupule ca 1 mm long, with subsidiary cymules developing below and around the first one, each with the central flower female and the lateral flowers female or male; central female flower subtended by its own bracteal cupule oriented decussately to the lower one. Fruit globose, sessile, smooth, white to pale yellow.

description: Plant slender, erect, much-branched, to 0.5 m high. Stem internodes terete, 10–30 mm long, ca 1 mm wide below, slightly widened above and somewhat enlarged at the nodes, striate longitudinally. Leaves normally developed; lamina obovate, attenuate at the base, subsessile, thin, rounded at the apex, curvinerved, usually with 3 veins faintly visible on both sides, 10–30 by 6–16 mm. Inflorescences axillary and sometimes terminal, a pedunculate or subsessile cymule of 3 flowers subtended by a cupule ca 1 mm long, usually with subsidiary cymules developing below and around the first one, with the central flower female and the lateral flowers male; female flower subtended by its own bracteal cupule oriented decussately to the lower one; peduncle 1–2 mm long, enlarging slightly under the fruit. Fruit globose or slightly ellipsoid, sessile or very shortly stipitate, sometimes weakly tuberculate when young but soon smooth.

description: Plant slender to robust, pendulous. Stem internodes flattened, widest above the middle or at the apex, with 1–5 longitudinal veins raised and distinct on each side and the middle one often more prominent, 20–60 mm long, 3–10 mm wide. Leaves rudimentary, erect, 0.2–0.3 mm long. Inflorescence axillary, a sessile cymule of 3 flowers subtended by a cupule ca 1 mm long, with subsidiary cymules developing below and around the first one, each with the central flower female and the lateral flowers female or male; central female flower subtended by its own bracteal cupule oriented decussately to the lower one. Fruit ellipsoid to oblong, sessile, smooth, yellow, red or brown.

description: Plant slender to robust, erect or penduluos, to 1.5 m high/long. Stem internodes more or less terete below, often compressed or flattened and ridged upwards, striate, 30–80 mm long, 1–4 mm wide below, widened to 2–5 mm above. Leaves normally developed; lamina lanceolate, falcate, attenuate at the base to an obscure petiole 2–5 mm long, thin, weakly acuminate and acute to broadly acute at the apex, curvinerved, usually with 5–7 veins visible on both sides, 50–110 by 10–20 mm. Inflorescence axillary, sometimes produced on short lateral shoots lacking normally developed leaves and then appearing spicate, a pedunculate cymule of usually 5 flowers subtended by a cupule ca 2 mm long, the cupule sometimes subtended by a lower cupule oriented decussately, usually with many subsidiary inflorescences developing around the first one, usually with the middle 3 flowers female and the lateral flowers male; peduncle dilated upwards, 1.5–5 mm long, with one or two pairs of minute deltoid prophylls at the base. Fruit ellipsoid, attenuate below to a stipe 3–6 mm long, truncate at the apex, smooth, often with 2 or 3 developing together in each cupule.

description: Plant slender to robust, pendulous. Stem internodes flattened, widest above the middle or at the apex, with 1–5 (usually 3) longitudinal veins raised and distinct on each side and the middle one often more prominent, 20–60 mm long, 3–10 mm wide. Inflorescence axillary, a sessile cymule of 3 flowers subtended by a cupule ca 1 mm long, with subsidiary cymules developing below and around the first one, with the central flower female and the lateral flowers female or male; central female flower subtended by its own bracteal cupule oriented decussately to the lower one. description: Plant slender to robust, erect, to 1.5 m high. Stem internodes terete, sometimes flattened and double-edged upwards, 10–60 mm long, 1–4 mm wide below, widened to 2–5 mm above, striate or weakly ridged longitudinally. Leaves mostly normally developed; lamina narrowly elliptic to obovate, sometimes falcate when narrow, attenuate at the base to an obscure petiole 2–5 mm long, often undulate at the margin, rounded to acute and shortly mucronate at the apex, curvinerved, usually with 3 veins visible on both sides, 25–120 by 10–40 mm. Inflorescence axillary, sometimes produced on short lateral shoots lacking normally developed leaves and then appearing spicate, a pedunculate or sessile cymule of 3 flowers subtended by a cupule ca 1 mm long, usually with many subsidiary cymules developing around the first one, with the middle flower female and the lateral flowers male; peduncle 0–5 mm long. Fruit globose or slightly ellipsoid, usually attenuate at the base, rarely on a short stipe to 3 mm long, distinctly tuberculate before maturity, yellow, orange or red.

description: Plant slender to moderately robust, erect or pendulous, to 1 m long. Stem internodes terete or decussately flattened or compressed, quadrangular or double-edged, then often with a raised angular rib on each face, usually distinctly longitudinally ribbed, 15–60 mm long, ca 1.5 mm wide below, widened to ca 3 mm above. Leaves rudimentary, spreading, 0.2–0.5 mm long. Inflorescences 1 or sometimes 2 in the axils, rarely with subsidiary cymules developing lateral to the first one, a sessile cymule of 3 flowers subtended by a cupule ca 1 mm long, with the central flower female and the lateral flowers female or male; central female flower subtended by its own bracteal cupule oriented decussately to the lower one. Fruit ellipsoid to almost globose, sessile, smooth, yellow to red, often striate.

description: Plant moderately robust, erect. Stem internodes almost terete or compressed or flattened and somewhat double-edged, longitudinally ribbed, 25–50 mm long, 1–2 mm wide below, widened to 2–4 mm above. Leaves normally developed; lamina spathulate to obovate, attenuate at the base to an obscure petiole 2–4 mm long, dark and slightly lustrous on both surfaces, shortly rounded or obtuse at the apex, 25–50 by 12–25 mm, curvinerved with 3 or 5 veins obscure. Inflorescences axillary and terminal, a pedunculate cymule of 3 flowers, subtended by a cupule ca 1 mm long, with subsidiary cymules sometimes developing adjacent to the first, with the middle flower female and the lateral flowers male; peduncle 1–3 mm long. Fruit globose or depressed-globose, on a stipe 2.5–4 mm long, usually smooth and shining, sometimes weakly tuberculate, with a short distinct neck, yellow-green to yellow-brown.
